jobs.description:
Description:

**Job Title:** Program Leader II (ADULTS)

**Employer:** Pomeroy Recreation and Rehabilitation Center

**Reports To:** Program Supervisor

**Department:** Adult Day

**Employment Status:** Full-time

**Starting Rate:** $24.50/hour

**Position Summary:** Under the supervision of the Program Supervisor, the Program Leader II provides services and supports for individuals with disabilities. A Program Leader II is responsible for a variety of activities such as planning and leading opportunities for growth and development, working directly with individuals to encourage participation in activities, providing instruction, and carrying out supports related to the physical well-being and comfort of persons served. The Program Leader II may also assist in the orienting and training of new staff, interns, and volunteers as assigned.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Service Delivery:**

* Provide instruction, support, and supervision to one or more persons served in a variety of activities and environments.
* Understand and consistently apply appropriate teaching strategies when working with persons served.
* Responsible for the safety of individuals served including observing and meeting safety requirements in both facility and community-based activities.
* Assist individuals with eating, toileting, personal hygiene, dressing, and other daily living skills as needed.
* Provide physical assistance to persons served including transferring, pushing wheelchairs, loading, and unloading from vehicles, and physical guidance as needed.
* Support and facilitate participant involvement in swimming and aquatic activities as needed, based on program schedules and participant interest. Swimming instruction or participation may be required as part of program responsibilities, with appropriate flexibility for medical restrictions, safety considerations, and other individual circumstances.
* Provide all other aspects of service delivery as needed.

**Program Coordination:**

* Responsible for the development and implementation of Individual Service Plans, goals and objectives, based on the needs/interests of persons served.
* Responsible for the planning, facilitating, executing, and evaluating social, vocational, recreational, self-help/advocacy, developmental activities, and skills training through in-center groups, work activities, and community-based outings in accordance with the individual’s service plan.
* Demonstrate ability to adapt teaching techniques, materials, and equipment to meet individual/group abilities, needs, and interests.
* Ensure program supplies are available for activities, including setting up and breaking down rooms/materials.
* Identify and collaboratively work with other team members in use of community and center resources to enhance individual growth and development opportunities. Suggest ideas to develop new activities and service planning skills.
* Assist with daily/weekly/monthly programming and activities as required.
* Provide other aspects of program coordination as needed.

**Administrative/Professional:**

* Maintain individual records and submit accurate reports per procedures established by the department. Includes initiating communication (oral and written) on successes, specific problems, or concerns of persons served.
* Work effectively as part of a team to accomplish the mission of PRRC. This includes developing and maintaining positive relations with persons served, care providers, employers, staff, affiliated organizations, and the community in general.
* Attend staff meetings and professional growth classes including in-services, conferences, and workshops.
* Assist supervisors with training new staff, interns, or volunteers as needed
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:** To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Possess ability to perform and teach basic mathematical skills, operations using units of American money, and weight, volume and distance measurements. Demonstrate the ability to problem solve practical problems and deal with an array of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists. Bachelor’s degree in rehabilitation counseling, vocational rehabilitation, or related field preferred. Knowledge of Americans with Disabilities Act and other laws – preferred. Bilingual preferred.

Requirements:

* One year related experience and/or training working with individuals with disabilities
* Working effectively with a variety of personalities and to be sensitive to the needs/communication of persons with differing abilities
* Ability to work independently on assigned tasks as well as to accept direction on given assignments
* Ability to perform multiple tasks and projects with varying time sensitive deadlines.
* Proficient and competent in the latest versions of Microsoft Office software (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Publisher, etc.) FileMaker, Windows and Macintosh programs/operating systems, email, and Internet.
* Criminal Record Clearance

**COMPETENCIES:**

jobs.title: Customer Support Advocate
jobs.description:
**“Improving the lives of those with chronic care diseases while providing solutions to our customers.'**

*Looking for a new opportunity? At SuperCare Health you have the chance to reach your dreams by helping us in serving the healthcare needs of our ever-growing patient population. Matching passion with careers, here hard work has never been so satisfying.*

*\*\*Hybrid role to our Fairfiel, Fresno, Milpitas, Modesto,Monterey, Rancho Cordova SCH Branch\*\**

**Who We Are:**  
SuperCare Health (SCH) is the foremost post-acute, in-home healthcare provider in the Western U.S., dedicated to serving the healthcare needs of our expanding patient population for nearly 50 years. Specializing in respiratory and chronic disease management, we have earned our position as a leader in the industry by delivering innovative solutions that significantly enhance the quality of life for our patients. Our unwavering commitment to excellence has established us as a trusted partner for healthcare providers nationwide.

**What We’re Looking For:**  
SuperCare Health is seeking an experienced and collaborative Customer Support Advocate to bridge relationships between internal and external parties to the company. The Customer Support Advocate (CSA) for Managed Care serves as the liaison between various departments including Contracting, Sales, Referrals, and Customer Service. They ensure timely handling of orders and authorizations to meet service level agreements (SLAs) by communicating with relevant teams. Responsibilities include identifying and resolving vulnerabilities, maintaining communication with strategic partners, and supporting Respiratory Account Executives (RAEs). Under the supervision of the Customer Service Manager, the CSA maintains communication between referral sources, Health Plans, Sales, Clinical, Distribution, and Customer Service. They monitor daily order activity, address escalations, and identify error patterns to educate teams and referral sources.

**What You’ll Do:**

**Monitoring and Oversight:**

* Monitor and review daily tasks within the order process using internal dashboards
* Alert supervisors and managers about any backlog or concerns affecting SLA compliance or contractual relationships
* Identify key issues affecting order processing efficiency and collaborate with teams or individuals to address delays or errors

**Communication and Coordination:**

* Serve as a primary contact for strategic partners and referrals, providing updates on order statuses and inventory availability
* Participate in regular meetings with relevant teams to analyze inventory needs based on order volume
* Review daily order cancellations, reporting trends to management and referral sources to prevent SLA disruptions

**Order Processing and Resolution:**

* Process urgent order requests across all Managed Care queues
* Personally manage orders if necessary to meet SLAs

**Training and Development:**

* Participate in company in-services, product training sessions, and coverage training

**Meeting Attendance and Adherence:**

* Attend all department and company meetings
* Adhere to SuperCare Health company policies

**Other Duties and Flexibility:**

* Be available for weekend assignments as needed or scheduled
* Potentially travel for up to 20% of assigned work duties
* Perform any other duties as requested by management

**This role may be a fit if you have…**

* Customer service experience with a medical supply company or demonstrated success in the Customer Care Specialist – L3 position
* Knowledge of diagnosis and medical terminology
* Knowledge of Insurance Payer landscape and eligibility/paperwork requirements
* Working knowledge of the full range of products offered by SuperCare and the review process needed to dispense them
* Excellent communication skills both verbal and written
* Proficiency in Google Workspace tools (Gmail, Google Sheets, Google Docs, Google Slides)
* Capacity to work on multiple tasks, plan and prioritize activities to achieve results and meet deadlines
* Strong organizational skills and detail oriented

**Benefits:**

* Medical
* Dental
* Vision
* Flexible Savings Account
* 401K
* Voluntary Life Insurance
* Observed Holidays: New Year's Day, Memorial Day, July 4th, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day, Christmas Day.

**Perks:**

* Paid Training
* Paid Time Off
* Sick Time
* Growth Opportunities
* Employee Referral Reward Program
* Employee Discount Program
* Compensation dependent on experience & qualifications

**What SuperCare Health is About**

*'SuperCare Health is a comprehensive, post-acute care, respiratory services company, focused on managing high-risk respiratory patients in their homes.*

*Today, SuperCare health manages millions of lives annually, with a growing team of more than 400 members, and has one of the highest-rated satisfaction scores from both our customers and patients.*

*Our goal is to be the most trusted and preferred resource to manage high-risk, post-acute respiratory patients through our high-touch clinical team and high-tech, innovative solutions. Our end-to- end care solutions, from the hospital to the home, close gaps in care, reduce costs of care and improve outcomes. Our in-home services include ventilation, oxygen, CPAP/BiPAP, enteral nutrition, pharmacy services, and an expanding population health program.*

*We are uniquely structured to be a responsive and agile community provider, yet we also possess the stability and effectiveness of a large enterprise. As a thriving business, our chief focus is on what really matters: reducing hospital re-admissions, optimizing outcomes and improving the lives of patients with chronic care diseases, every day.*

**Connect With Us!**

Company Website: https://supercarehealth.com/

Company Business Hours - 8:30 AM – 5:30 PM PST

jobs.title: Call Center Representative
jobs.description:
Summary

  

The Call Center Representative is responsible for ensuring that all calls are answered in a timely fashion, with a pleasant attitude, providing high-level customer services to all patients and callers. Schedules medical patient visits, and answers call for dental and behavioral health. Obtains necessary data and insurance authorizations as appropriate.

  

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Customer Care:

* Answers and directs calls with a pleasant voice in a timely manner
* Schedules patients in accordance with established provider schedules and clinic protocols
* Records no-shows and cancellations in system and patient records while routing patient messages to appropriate clinical staff
* Screens and provides information to patients on Sliding Fee Scale as appropriate
* Accurately captures patient demographics, insurance and structured data into the EHR system with each patient encounter
* Advises patients of clinic policies regarding scheduling, payments, no-shows, etc. and answers questions as appropriate, advises patients to bring in necessary financial and/or insurance documentation as indicated
* Monitors call volume alerts supervisor of changes
* Maintains strict patient confidentiality per HIPPA and company standards
* Ensure superior customer service to patients, including problem resolution
* Performs a variety of miscellaneous clerical tasks as time permits
* Performs other duties as directed, developed or assigned

  

Insurances:

* Verify insurance eligibility at the time of scheduling, with emphasis on Medi-Cal, Medicare, and HMO plans.
* Identify and communicate any eligibility issues to frontline staff before patient visits, ensuring accurate payment or insurance updates are made in advance.
* Document detailed eligibility notes in the appointment billing screen for clear communication with the billing department

Supervisory Responsibility: N/A

  

Qualification Requirements:

  

* High school diploma or equivalency
* Knowledge of standard office policies and procedures
* Experience working on computers; typing/keyboarding speed of at least 40 WPM
* Must have a positive attitude, be a team player, and be able to take directions from supervisor
* Understands and promote the mission, vision, and values of the health center both in the workplace and in the community
* Sensitivity to the needs and situation of multi-cultural population from a variety of income levels
* Ability to manage multiple tasks
* Excellent customer service skills and ability to effectively and respectfully handle dissatisfied patients
* Experience in a medical office setting/FQHC setting
* Responsible for extensive knowledge of programs/insurance & access/eligibility guidelines & applications (including Medi-Cal, CHDP, CPSP, Presumptive Eligibility, Family Pact, Sliding Scale)
* Must possess excellent organization, writing, and verbal skills
* English proficiency required; Spanish proficiency preferred
* Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form

  

Equipment/Machinery: Fax machine, copier, personal computer, telephone, calculator, Microsoft Word/Excel, EHR system, and other software as required.

  

Physical Demands: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an individual to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  

* Stand and walk or sit alternatively depending on specific needs of day. Estimate 20% of time is spent on feet and 80% sitting at desk.
* Have occasional need to perform the following physical activities: bend/stoop/squat, climb stairs, push or pull, reach above shoulders.
* Have occasional need to perform standing and walking activities.
* Constant need to perform the following physical activities: writing/typing, grasping/turning, finger dexterity.
* Lifting/carrying over 10 pounds occasionally. Lifting/carrying less than 10 pounds frequently.

  

Vision requirements: constant need to complete forms, read reports, view computer screen. Frequent need to see small detail. Frequent need to see things clearly beyond arm's reach.

  

Hearing requirements: constant need to communicate over telephone and in person.

  

Travel Requirements: Occasional need to utilize personal transportation to attend meetings or training.

  

Work Environment: The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

jobs.title: Senior People Operations Solutions Manager, Service Delivery
jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

**About the Role:**

When someone at Crusoe needs help with a People question, they should know exactly where to go and get a fast, accurate answer, whether they sit at a desk or work a shift on a manufacturing floor. You'll build that front door.

As the Senior People Operations Solutions Manager for HR Service Delivery, you are the product manager for how employees and managers get help: the People portal, case management, the knowledge platform, AI agents and the channels people use to reach us, from mobile and text to phone and on-site kiosks. AI and knowledge answer first, and people step in where judgment and care matter. Every case a person solves should make the knowledge, and the AI, better next time.

Reporting to the Director, People Operations Solutions you lead solution teams with Employee Care, the Knowledge Manager, Lifecycle Operations, UX design, analytics and IT. You'll bring a bias toward automation and AI, and the judgment to keep a human in the loop where it counts.

**What You'll Be Working On:**

* Service delivery platform: own the roadmap for the People portal, case management and AI agent, from platform selection through launch and continuous improvement.
* Experience design: use design thinking to understand how employees and managers look for help, prototype with them, and design service journeys that work for desk-based and frontline teammates alike.
* Channels: design how people reach us across portal, chat, mobile, text, phone, AI voice and on-site kiosks, with live translation and simple sign-in for teammates without a company email or computer.
* Case management: design intake, routing, tiering and escalation so every request is tracked, owned and closed by the right team, and reaches the right expert with full context.
* Knowledge platform: with the Knowledge Manager, build the knowledge base and the practices that help content owners keep it accurate, so AI and self-service resolve more questions over time.
* AI and automation: design AI agents and automated workflows that answer questions and complete simple requests, with clear hand-offs to people and guardrails for sensitive matters.
* Service catalog: define and maintain the catalog of People services, with owners, tiers and service levels for each.
* Roadmap and delivery: own the backlog for service delivery products and deliver in short cycles with demos to business owners.
* Measurement and improvement: own product measures such as touchless resolution, end-user satisfaction, effort, service levels and cost to serve, and use the results to drive design improvements.
* Technology partnership: lead the work with IT using agile development practices, including a shared backlog, sprint planning, regular demos and joint testing. Translate requirements into configuration and integration decisions across the service platform, Workday, collaboration tools and identity.
* Launch and adoption: prepare readiness, enablement and adoption with Change Management and Employee Care for each release.

**What You'll Bring to the Team:**

* We don't expect anyone to bring everything below. If you meet the requirements and some of the rest, we'd like to hear from you.
* **Required**

  + 8+ years in HR service delivery, employee experience, IT or HR service management, or product management for employee-service software, with several end-to-end launches
  + Process design skill: service blueprints, routing and escalation design, standard work and service levels
  + Comfort with service data: you set targets, read the trends and act on them
  + Energy for the pace of a fast-scaling company and a path not fully paved
* **Equivalent experience we value equally**

  + Service platform: implementing or running ServiceNow HRSD, or a comparable case and knowledge platform in HR, IT or customer service
  + Knowledge management: designing knowledge practices, ideally Knowledge-Centered Service, or KCS, ITIL or Lean Six Sigma training
  + AI: deploying conversational AI, chatbots or AI agents for employee or customer support, or designing automated workflows with clear hand-offs to people
  + Product delivery: design thinking and agile methods from business case through adoption, or product management at an HR service delivery, ITSM or customer-service software company

**Bonus Points**

* Serving deskless or hourly workforces, including kiosks, text and mobile channels
* Contact-center operations, telephony or AI voice experience
* Multilingual support and live translation

**Benefits:**

* Competitive compensation and equity packages
* Restricted Stock Units
* Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs
* Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance
* Employer contributions to HSA account
* Paid parental leave

jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Manager of Operations provides full-time leadership and oversight for the day-to-day operations of Anvil Property Management Corporation's affordable-housing portfolio. This position serves as the primary operational link between executive leadership and property-site teams, ensuring that properties are staffed, compliant, responsive, financially disciplined, and operating in accordance with company standards, owner expectations, and applicable housing requirements.

This is a hands-on field leadership role. The Manager of Operations is expected to maintain a consistent presence at assigned properties, coach site teams, resolve operational barriers, verify completion of critical work, and provide timely, accurate reporting to executive leadership.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Property and Site Operations

· Oversee daily operations across Anvil-managed properties and ensure consistent application of company policies, procedures, and performance standards.

· Maintain a regular site-visit schedule; observe property conditions, review office and maintenance workflows, meet with site staff, and follow through on identified concerns.

· Monitor occupancy, vacancies, unit turns, leasing activity, rent collection, work orders, preventive maintenance, inspections, vendor activity, resident concerns, and property emergencies.

· Establish clear priorities, owners, deadlines, and follow-up procedures for operational assignments.

· Coordinate coverage and continuity plans for vacancies, absences, emergencies, and staffing transitions.

· Escalate material risks promptly while independently resolving routine operational matters within delegated authority.

Affordable Housing Compliance

· Support site compliance with HUD, CAHI, fair housing, Section 504, reasonable-accommodation, tenant-selection, EIV, income-certification, annual-recertification, and other applicable program requirements.

· Track time-sensitive submissions, recertifications, management reviews, corrective-action plans, resident notices, waiting-list activities, and owner or agency requests.

· Review operational files and reports for completeness, timeliness, consistency, and protection of personally identifiable information.

· Coordinate preparation for MORs, audits, inspections, lender reviews, and agency monitoring; oversee corrective actions through verified completion.

· Partner with compliance consultants, legal counsel, contract administrators, housing agencies, and ownership representatives as directed.

Staff Leadership and Accountability

· Provide direct supervision, coaching, and performance oversight to assigned site leaders and operational staff.

· Set measurable expectations; conduct regular one-on-one and team check-ins; document assignments, progress, performance concerns, and outcomes.

· Identify training needs and coordinate training on housing compliance, software, documentation, customer service, safety, and company procedures.

· Support recruitment, onboarding, scheduling, performance-improvement plans, corrective action, and offboarding in coordination with executive leadership and human-resources support.

· Promote a culture of accountability, professionalism, respectful resident service, collaboration, and timely communication.

Maintenance, Vendors, and Risk Management

· Monitor preventive maintenance, unit inspections, capital needs, unit rehabilitation, vendor performance, contracts, bids, invoices, insurance documentation, and scope completion.

· Confirm that procurement and approval requirements are followed and that proposed costs are reasonable, supported, and within budget or approved authority.

· Monitor health, safety, habitability, security, pest-control, and property-condition concerns; coordinate prompt corrective action and required reporting.

· Maintain operational readiness for after-hours incidents and ensure site teams understand escalation and emergency-response protocols.

Financial and Performance Oversight

· Review property operating results, budgets, expense trends, vacancy loss, delinquency, vendor spending, and other key performance indicators in collaboration with accounting and executive leadership.

· Help site teams manage operations within approved budgets and provide timely explanations and action plans for material variances.

· Verify the timely completion and submission of operational reports, rent postings, voucher-related information, purchase requests, invoices, and supporting documentation.

· Recommend process improvements that strengthen efficiency, internal controls, service quality, and portfolio performance.

Executive Communication and Administration

· Prepare or review reports, procedures, correspondence, action plans, and meeting materials for executive leadership, ownership, and external partners.

· Lead operational meetings and maintain written accountability for decisions, assignments, and due dates.

· Carry out additional operational responsibilities and special projects consistent with the position and organizational needs.

jobs.title: Airfreight Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

As an Airfreight Operations Manager, you must be capable of independently managing shipments from the initial customer request through quoting, dispatch, pickup, airline recovery or tender, shipment monitoring, documentation, and final delivery. This role requires an individual who understands both the operational and documentation sides of air freight and can make accurate, time-sensitive decisions without continuous supervision.

**Duties**

* Manage daily air freight and time-critical transportation operations. • Coordinate airline recoveries, airline tenders, pickups, transfers, and final-mile deliveries.
* Review customer shipment requests and determine the appropriate vehicle, driver, routing, and service requirements.
* Quickly reroute or switch drivers when delays, schedule changes, breakdowns, or other operational issues occur.
* Dispatch and route multiple drivers while considering location, shipment priority, airline cutoff times, vehicle type, and delivery deadlines.
* Prepare, review, and verify air freight documentation, including MAWB, IAC paperwork, airline labels, PPW, and customer-specific documentation.
* Understand airline cargo recovery and tender procedures, cargo terminal requirements, and cutoff times.
* Prepare accurate transportation quotations based on shipment requirements, mileage, vehicle type, waiting time, additional stops, and special handling.
* Monitor active shipments from dispatch through completion and provide accurate status updates.
* Communicate professionally with customers, drivers, airlines, cargo facilities, warehouses, and internal teams.
* Identify potential service failures and take proactive corrective action.
* Handle operational exceptions including airline delays, incorrect or missing documentation, missed cutoffs, driver issues, facility closures, and shipment changes.
* Maintain knowledge of customer-specific SOPs and shipment requirements.
* Review driver paperwork, proof of pickup, proof of delivery, airline tender documentation, and shipment records for accuracy.
* Assist in training operations personnel on airline procedures, documentation, driver routing, and customer requirements.

**Experience**

* Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in air freight, freight forwarding, airport logistics, courier operations, expedited transportation, or a related field preferred.
* Strong hands-on experience with airline cargo operations.
* Strong working knowledge of MAWB, IAC procedures, airline labels, PPW, and air freight documentation.
* Experience coordinating airline cargo recoveries and tenders. Page 1 NEONLINE LOGISTICS INC.
* Proven experience dispatching and routing multiple drivers and shipments simultaneously.
* Ability to understand shipment dimensions, weights, vehicle requirements, routing, and operational priorities.
* Experience preparing customer transportation or logistics quotations.
* Experience communicating directly with customers, freight forwarders, airlines, warehouses, and drivers.
* Experience with pharmaceutical, life-science, temperature-sensitive, or time-critical transportation is highly preferred.
* Previous supervisory, lead, or operations-management experience is preferred.

Pay: $80,000.00 - $120,000.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Hayward, CA 94545

**Company Description**

XP Power is a major supplier of critical power conversion technology to the medical, technology, industrial, and defence markets. We are a fast-growing company listed on the London Stock Exchange. We are looking for self-motivated professionals who thrive in dynamic environments. We are proud of and committed to our culture that values Customer Focus, Flexibility, Knowledge, Speed, and Integrity. jobs.title: Senior People Operations Solutions Manager, Talent Lifecycle
jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

**About the Role:**

Crusoe is growing fast across offices, data centers and manufacturing sites in several countries. How we set goals, review performance, develop our people and bring new talent in shapes how every employee experiences Crusoe, and how quickly they grow with us.

As Senior People Operations Solutions Manager for the talent lifecycle, you are the product manager for how Crusoe reviews, grows and hires its people. Your focus is the systems that enable talent performance cycle and ongoing talent development: goals, check-ins, mid-year and year-end reviews, calibration, learning and career growth. You also design the recruiting lifecycle in Ashby and Workday and its hand-off into onboarding. You start from the outcome the business needs, partner with Centers of Excellence, design with the employees and managers who use the process, and deliver a complete solution across people, process and technology.

Reporting to the Director, People Operations Solutions , you lead solution teams partnering with our Talent and Learning teams, Talent Acquisition, Lifecycle Operations, UX design, analytics and IT. You'll bring a bias toward automation and AI, and the judgment to add process where it creates value and keep it light where it doesn't.

**What You'll Be Working On:**

* Talent performance cycle: partner with Talent and Performance Management to deliver the performance cycle end-to-end, owning the workflow, system configuration, cycle operations, and user experience, making each cycle simpler and more useful for employees and managers.
* Ongoing talent development: build the processes and tools that deliver learning, career paths, internal mobility and succession programs designed by the Talent and Learning teams, so growth at Crusoe is continuous, visible and easy to act on.
* Manager enablement: partner with Talent and Performance Management to give managers the tools, data and prompts to coach, recognize and develop their teams between formal cycles.
* Recruiting lifecycle: own the recruiting workflow across Ashby and Workday, from requisition to offer accepted, and its connection to onboarding, including the candidate portal.
* Discovery and outcomes: define success with program owners and the people who use the process. Map the current journey, measure it and find the constraints.
* Solution design: use design thinking to frame the problem and prototype with employees and managers. Then design future-state journeys across people, process and technology, including service blueprints, standard work, controls and where AI or automation should take on manual work.
* Roadmap and delivery: own the roadmap and backlog for talent lifecycle products, and deliver in short cycles with demos to business owners.
* Technology partnership: lead the work with IT using agile development practices, including a shared backlog, sprint planning, regular demos and joint testing. Translate requirements into configuration and integration decisions for Workday Talent, Performance and Learning, Workday Recruiting and Ashby, and the tools around them.
* Launch and adoption: prepare readiness, enablement and adoption with Change Management, and hand each product to Lifecycle Operations with clear standards.
* Measurement and improvement: enable tracking of measures such as cycle completion and quality, manager and employee satisfaction, internal mobility, time to hire and data quality, and keep improving after launch.
* Global scale: design for many countries, entities and sites, including manufacturing and data center teams.

**What You'll Bring to the Team:**

We don't expect anyone to bring everything below. If you meet the requirements and some of the rest, we'd like to hear from you.

### **Required**

* 8+ years in talent management, performance and development programs, HR technology or HR product management, with several end-to-end launches
* Deep knowledge of performance management and talent development processes
* Process design skill: journey and process mapping, standard work, SOPs and RACI
* Comfort with data: you define the measures and act on what they show
* The ability to lead without authority and build trust with managers, talent and learning partners, recruiters and IT
* Energy for the pace of a fast-scaling company and a path not fully paved

### **Equivalent experience we value equally**

* Talent technology: Workday Talent and Performance, or comparable depth in another talent management system
* Recruiting: an applicant tracking system such as Ashby or Workday Recruiting, or hands-on recruiting operations experience
* Product delivery: design thinking and agile methods from business case through adoption, or product management at a talent management, learning or HCM software company
* Process improvement: Lean, Six Sig

**About Us**

At Claremont Resort & Club, we believe that exceptional hospitality starts with extraordinary people. For over a century, our iconic resort has set the standard for luxury and service in the Bay Area. We take pride in creating memorable experiences for our guests—and a rewarding, inclusive workplace for our colleagues. Situated on 22 acres in the Berkeley and Oakland Hills, Claremont Resort & Club seamlessly blends its rich 19th-century history with the modern day to offer the very best of the Bay Area. Guests dine with friends at Limewood, relax at our urban oasis, The Spa at the Claremont, and discover total wellness at The Club at the Claremont- all while taking in the breathtaking views of the San Francisco Bay.

Don't meet every single requirement of this job? At HEI we are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to still send in your information. You may be the perfect candidate for this or for other roles within our organization!  
  
We value U.S. military experience and invite all qualified military candidates to apply.

**Compensation**

Salary Range: $71,636.00 - $95,511.00 AnnuallyTipped/Service Charge Eligible? NoDiscretionary Performance Bonus Eligible? No

The Club Operations Manager leads the spaces and systems members rely on every day. * Embrace and support the Claremont and HEI Core Values.

**Qualiﬁcatons**

  

* [3+] years in club, resort, hotel, or facility operatons, including [2+] years in leadership.

* Budget ownership and the ability to track and report expenses.
* Retail merchandising or buying experience preferred.

We’re unlike any other residential energy company. Our vertically integrated model gives us total control over every part of the energy lifecycle – from sale through installation and beyond – so you can find endless opportunities for growth. Come join a career you can grow in and a culture you can run with.  
  
Who We Are

We’re on a mission to make energy more reliable and affordable for more people. We provide an opportunity with storage and solar to help people access greater energy independence without the big upfront costs. Sunrun is the largest dedicated residential solar and storage company in the country and has a mission to bring stably priced resilient power to the masses.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Technical Operations Supervisor (TOS) reports directly to the Technical Operations Manager and is the front line leader for Technicians in the field. The TOS is responsible for ensuring that each Technician meets Sunrun operating standards for safety and performance.

jobs.title: Senior Operations Manager, Road Safety
jobs.description:
**About the Role**  
  
We’re looking for a highly analytical, detail-oriented Operations Manager to help shape and drive our global four-wheel Road Safety program across Mobility and Delivery. You’ll identify the biggest opportunities to reduce crash frequency and severity, build proactive solutions, and partner across teams to deliver measurable improvements.  
  
You’ll combine strategic judgment with hands-on execution: digging into incident trends, challenging assumptions, developing proactive interventions, and ensuring rigorous quality as programs scale. You’ll build with heart, grounding decisions in the experiences of drivers, couriers, riders, and others who share the road. We welcome strong operators from varied backgrounds who are motivated to make a meaningful impact on road safety.  
  
**What You’ll Do**  
  

* **Build and launch proactive interventions:** Develop operational programs, driver education, communications, and partnerships to address road safety risks. Turn ideas into pilots, build the materials and processes needed for launch, and work with regions to scale what works.
* **Turn insights into priorities:** Analyze crash trends and dangerous driving behaviors, investigate root causes and data gaps, and recommend where to focus. Use evidence, regional feedback, and implementation feasibility to inform the four-wheel Road Safety roadmap.
* **Drive programs from idea to impact:** Turn priorities into effective programs, taking ownership from design through implementation and evaluation. Get into the details, remove blockers, and continuously improve the quality and effectiveness of our interventions.
* **Be the global go-to for four-wheel road safety:** Develop a deep understanding of our risks, products, and operational interventions. Identify gaps and opportunities across the suite, and partner with Product, Engineering, and Data Science to prioritize and build improvements.
* **Build community and bring teams together:** Be the glue across global and regional partners, including Product, Engineering, Data Science, Legal, Policy, and Operations. Build a road safety community that shares learnings, solves implementation challenges, and follows through on decisions and commitments.
* **Shape global road safety standards:** Develop global minimum standards grounded in data, risk assessments, and regional insights. Partner with regional teams to put them into practice and continuously strengthen how we prevent and address road safety risks.

  
**Basic Qualifications**  
  

* Bachelor's Degree
* 4+ years experience of operations, investment banking, consulting, business intelligence, strategy or related experience
* Excel proficiency (modeling, data visualization) and/or working knowledge in applying SQL, Python, Stata or similar statistical language

  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
  

* Experience in Operations, Trust & Safety, BizOps, or related fields.
* Practical experience applying risk management frameworks; familiarity with road safety risks is a plus.
* Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills; expert SQL proficiency is a plus.
* Experience designing pilots or experiments and evaluating intervention effectiveness.
* Curiosity about AI and a willingness to experiment, rethink existing workflows, and evaluate whether new approaches improve quality and impact.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Project Manager
jobs.description:
**About Range Energy**
----------------------

Range Energy builds powered trailers that help electrify heavy-duty trucking without requiring fleets to replace their tractors. We solve real-world problems with real hardware.

Founded in 2021, Range is led by experienced EV operators from Tesla, Zoox, Honda, and other leading OEMs. We are backed by strong investors and focused on building hardware that fleets will actually use.

The work is hands-on. Sometimes messy. Often fast. Always meaningful.

**What we look for in every hire:** Mission first. Team second. Self third.

**Winning attitude & ownership.** We move fast and hold a high bar for execution. You own the outcome, not just your piece of it. When the path isn’t clear, you find a way. And when you’re stuck, you ask for help early.

**Curiosity & humility.** You ask good questions, learn fast, and stay low ego. You put the mission and the people around you ahead of your own credit, stay open to feedback, and are quick to admit when you’re wrong.

**Integrity & trust.** You tell the truth, especially when it’s bad news. You keep your commitments, own your mistakes, and do what’s right. And you treat others the way you’d want to be treated.

If you like building real things, solving hard problems, and working with low-drama, high-output teammates, you’ll fit here.

**Role Summary**
----------------

As a Supply Chain Project Manager, you will combine strategic sourcing ownership with hands-on program management for Range’s supply chain function. You will hold the bill of materials accountable to cost targets end-to-end, run the day-to-day coordination across a multi-supplier base, and act as the connective tissue between sourcing, engineering, and manufacturing so that supplier commitments translate into on-time, on-cost delivery. This role suits someone equally comfortable negotiating a contract and running the project plan that keeps a dozen suppliers moving in lockstep.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own cost performance across the entire bill of materials, identifying savings and value-engineering opportunities holistically rather than supplier-by-supplier.
* Serve as technical project manager for the supply chain team – organizing and coordinating multiple suppliers in parallel, tracking milestones, and resolving cross-supplier dependencies.
* Conduct market research and analysis to identify potential suppliers, evaluate their capabilities, and assess market trends, ensuring the selection of optimal suppliers.
* Negotiate favorable contractual terms and conditions with suppliers, including pricing, delivery schedules, quality requirements, and service levels.

* Continuously monitor and evaluate supplier performance against quality, delivery, and cost targets; implement corrective actions when necessary.
* Lead the day-to-day process of ensuring successful partnerships – milestone adherence, change order management, quality assurance, and cost control.
* Provide regular reports and analysis on sourcing metrics, program status, supplier performance, and cost savings to senior management.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* At least 5 years of experience in strategic sourcing, purchasing, and/or program management in a hardware product environment.
* Bachelor’s degree.
* Strategic sourcing, financial and business opportunity analysis, comfort with legal frameworks and contract negotiation skills (development, supply, licensing, and service agreements).
* Demonstrated experience running multi-workstream projects or programs – building and holding schedules, managing dependencies, and driving cross-functional accountability.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders, including C-level, engineering, legal, finance, manufacturing, and logistics.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and work in a team environment.
* Demonstrated ability to identify business process issues and drive process improvement.
* Deep experience in complex project management.
* Uncanny ability to execute.

**Preferred / Nice-to-Haves**

* Advanced (Master’s, Doctorate, etc.) degree in business, operations, supply chain, or a related field.
* Experience in the electric vehicle industry.
* Experience with automotive component supply chain.
* PMP or similar project/program management certification.
* Mandarin-speaking ability is a plus.

**Other Requirements**
----------------------

* This role requires regular onsite presence at Range HQ in Mountain View.
* Physical Requirements: Ability to work in a shop environment, including standing for extended periods and occasionally lifting up to 50 pounds. Comfortable with occasional bending, kneeling, and climbing as required for infrastructure maintenance. Ability to sustain extended periods of sitting and computer usage.
* Travel Requirements: Minimal, primarily for supplier visits or industry events.

**Compensation & Benefits**
---------------------------

Range Energy’s compensation package includes a competitive salary, equity for all full-time roles, and a generous benefits package. **Project Manager**

Onsite- Hayward, CA

### **Build Something That Makes an Impact.**

At AD/S, we bring ideas to life through custom signage, architectural features, displays, and fixtures that make a lasting impression. From illuminated landmarks that transform city skylines to wayfinding systems that guide people through airports, hospitals, resorts, and other major destinations, our work is seen and experienced every day.

We’re looking for an experienced Project Manager to join our team and take the lead on projects from contract award through final installation. In this role, you’ll be the driving force behind project execution by balancing budgets, schedules, quality, and customer expectations while collaborating with our sales, design, engineering, manufacturing, and installation teams to bring each project across the finish line.

### **What You’ll Do**

* **Lead Projects from Start to Finish:** Manage all phases of assigned projects, including design, permitting, fabrication, delivery, and installation.
* **Own Budgets and Profitability:** Develop and monitor project budgets, track costs, manage margins, and identify opportunities to protect profitability.
* **Keep Teams Aligned:** Coordinate schedules, deliverables, and resources across internal departments, subcontractors, vendors, and customers.
* **Build Customer Relationships:** Serve as the primary point of contact, communicate project updates, resolve concerns, and deliver a high level of customer service.
* **Oversee Field Activities:** Conduct site visits and field investigations, assess site conditions, and coordinate or oversee installation activities as needed.
* **Interpret Project Documentation:** Review and interpret blueprints, construction drawings, specifications, and design packages to ensure project requirements are understood and executed.
* **Manage Subcontractors:** Obtain and evaluate estimates, negotiate pricing, and coordinate subcontractors for permitting, installation, and related services.
* **Monitor Progress:** Maintain accurate project records, track milestones, and report project status using company software and internal systems.
* **Manage Changes and Closeout:** Prepare change orders, project updates, and invoices while ensuring scope changes and costs are properly documented.

### **What You Bring**

* 5+ years of project management experience in the signage or construction industry.
* Strong ability to read and interpret blueprints, construction drawings, specifications, and design packages.
* Proven ability to manage multiple projects, competing priorities, budgets, and deadlines.
* Excellent organizational, communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
* A customer-focused approach and the ability to build productive relationships with clients, subcontractors, and cross-functional teams.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Salesforce.
* A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset grounded in persistence, accountability, and integrity.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience.

* Valid driver’s license and a clean driving record.

### **Perks & Benefits**

We believe great work starts with a great team. AD/S offers:

* Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance.
* Paid vacation, sick time, and holidays.
* 401(k) retirement plan with company matching after the qualifying period.
* Employee referral bonuses and discounts.
* A collaborative environment where craftsmanship, teamwork, and professional growth matter.

### **Why AD/S?**

Our success is built on craftsmanship, teamwork, accountability, and integrity. We take pride in what we create, how we work together, and the relationships we build along the way.

**About Corvus**

We’re Corvus Robotics, a Physical AI company transforming how the world’s warehouses operate. By combining autonomous robotics, computer vision, and AI, we’re replacing manual, labor-intensive processes with intelligent systems that make inventory management safer, smarter, and more efficient.

Our flagship Corvus One drones autonomously track warehouse inventory around the clock, while Corvus Trident, our AI-powered forklift intelligence system, captures inventory movement in real time. Together, our technologies provide a complete picture of warehouse operations, helping enterprises improve accuracy, efficiency, and decision-making.

Our technology is widely deployed and delivering value for leading enterprises. We’re now building a future where warehouse operations are fully autonomous. At Corvus, you’ll have the opportunity to take ownership, solve challenging real-world problems, and help bring the next generation of intelligent robots to scale.

**About the Role**

At Corvus Robotics, we're scaling autonomous robotics across enterprise warehouses. We're looking for a Deployment Program Manager to own the end-to-end customer deployment process, from sales handoff through successful implementation and operational readiness.

You'll serve as the central point of coordination across Sales, Engineering, Customer Success, and field deployment teams, ensuring projects move efficiently from signed agreements to fully operational Corvus One systems.

This is a high-impact role for someone who thrives on ownership, cross-functional execution, and building scalable processes in a fast-growing robotics company.

**This field-based role requires approximately 20–30% travel** across the U.S., with occasional visits to our Mountain View headquarters. You'll work closely with customers and cross-functional teams to coordinate deployments, ensure site readiness, and drive successful implementations.

**What You'll Do**

* **Own end-to-end deployment programs:** Lead customer implementations from sales handoff through installation, commissioning, and operational handover.
* **Drive deployment planning:** Establish project timelines, milestones, resource requirements, and clear ownership across internal teams and customers.
* **Bridge Sales and Operations:** Translate customer commitments, site requirements, and commercial expectations into actionable deployment plans.
* **Coordinate cross-functional execution:** Partner with Sales, Engineering, Customer Success, and field teams to keep deployments on track.
* **Manage customer readiness:** Coordinate site assessments, infrastructure requirements, installation schedules, and customer dependencies.
* **Identify and resolve risks:** Proactively manage blockers, escalations, scope changes, and competing priorities to protect deployment timelines.
* **Build scalable processes:** Develop deployment playbooks, standardized workflows, and reporting to support growing deployment volumes.
* **Drive successful handoffs:** Ensure clear acceptance criteria, customer training, and a smooth transition to ongoing operations and support.

**What We're Looking For**

* Experience in technical program management, deployment management, implementation, or customer-facing operations.
* Proven ability to manage complex, cross-functional projects from planning through execution.
* Experience coordinating hardware installations, robotics, industrial automation, or other technical deployments.
* Strong project planning, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to translate technical and business requirements into clear execution plans.
* Excellent communication skills and confidence working with enterprise customers and technical teams.
* A hands-on, highly organized approach with the ability to drive accountability and execution in a fast-paced startup environment.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in robotics, warehouse automation, industrial IoT, or hardware-software integrated systems.
* Background managing enterprise customer implementations or multi-site rollouts.
* Familiarity with warehouse operations, logistics, networking, or site infrastructure.
* Experience developing deployment playbooks, operational KPIs, and scalable processes.
* Experience working closely with Sales during pre-deployment planning and post-sales handoffs.

**Why Join Corvus Robotics?**

**Build technology that works in the real world.** Be part of a team bringing autonomous robotics and AI into real-world environments, solving meaningful challenges and transforming warehouse operations.

**Own your impact.** Take ownership of meaningful work, contribute to important decisions, and see the direct impact of your contributions as we grow.

**Help scale the next generation of Physical AI.** Join at a pivotal stage of growth and help build the technology, teams, systems, and processes that will bring autonomous robotics to enterprise scale.

**Grow alongside the company.** Work with talented, driven people across disciplines, tackle new challenges, expand your skills, and help shape the future of Corvus Robotics.

Compensation Range: $110K - $140K

jobs.title: Patient Services and Consult Coordinator
jobs.description:
#### **POSITION SUMMARY**

The Patient Services and Consult Coordinator serves as the first point of contact for patients, families, referring offices, and visitors at the front desk, and as the primary point of contact for prospective patients from initial inquiry through the surgical consultation. At the front desk, this role manages check-in and check-out, patient registration, eligibility and benefits verification, scheduling, phones, and patient payments, keeping clinic sessions running on time. In the consult role, it reviews new patient inquiries, referrals, and intake submissions to confirm that required paperwork and documentation are complete; schedules consultations; and coordinates with providers, insurance verification, and financial counseling so that patients arrive at their consultation informed and prepared. Once a patient has completed the consultation and is confirmed to proceed with a surgical course, the coordinator completes a documented handoff to the Surgery Coordinator, who manages the patient through surgery scheduling, surgery, and postoperative follow-up. This is a nonclinical position; it does not include rooming patients, clinical assessment, triage, medical advice, medical decision-making, or tasks performed by medical assistants or licensed clinical staff.

#### **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

* Front Desk: General reception, front desk, and checking in patients responsibilities
* Consult Coordination: Serve as the primary point of contact for prospective and new patients from initial inquiry through completion of the surgical consultation.
* Consult Coordination: Respond to new patient inquiries, referrals, and intake submissions received by phone, email, patient portal, in person, or other approved channels within established response timelines.
* Consult Coordination: Explain the practice’s intake and consultation process, required documentation, general timelines, and what patients can expect before and after their consultation.
* Consult Coordination: Distribute, collect, and review intake packets, referral submissions, health history forms, financial policy acknowledgments, and the Notice of Privacy Practices acknowledgment for completeness, confirming receipt of required items such as demographic information, insurance information, identification, intake and consent forms, medical records, and letters of support or referral, as required by practice protocols and payer requirements.
* Consult Coordination: Identify missing, incomplete, expired, or inconsistent documentation and follow up with patients, referring providers, and outside offices to obtain it within established timelines.
* Consult Coordination: Route documentation requiring clinical review to the appropriate provider or clinical staff. The coordinator confirms that documents are present and complete but does not evaluate their clinical content or adequacy.
* Consult Coordination: Coordinate with insurance verification and financial counseling to confirm that eligibility, benefits, and any consultationrelated referral or authorization requirements are addressed before the consultation.
* Consult Coordination: Schedule, confirm, and reschedule inperson and telehealth consultations, and send appointment details, preconsultation instructions, and reminders.
* Consult Coordination: Serve as a liaison between assigned providers and prospective patients during the preconsultation stage for nonclinical questions, scheduling, and documentation needs.
* Consult Coordination: Conduct regular checkins with patients during the preconsultation period to keep them informed of outstanding requirements and next steps.
* Consult Coordination: Track each prospective patient’s status from inquiry through consultation, and maintain an accurate, current consult pipeline in the appropriate systems.
* Consult Coordination: Following the consultation, confirm the provider’s documented outcome and communicate nonclinical next steps to the patient.
* Consult Coordination: For patients confirmed to proceed with a surgical course, complete a timely, documented handoff to the Surgery Coordinator, including documentation status, any outstanding items, and relevant patient communication preferences.
* Consult Coordination: For patients who are not proceeding, or who must complete additional requirements before proceeding, communicate next steps as directed by the provider and document the patient’s status accordingly.
* Records: Scan, index, and file incoming records, faxes, and outside reports to the correct patient chart; route requests for release of medical records to the designated staff member in accordance with HIPAA, the California Confidentiality of Medical Information Act, and practice policy.

* Communicate outstanding requirements, scheduling changes, and next steps clearly and compassionately.

* Maintain regular and reliable attendance sufficient to meet the position’s operational, patientservice, and team obligations, with or without reasonable accommodation.

jobs.title: Career and Pathways Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Location:** San Francisco, CA (Hybrid)  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Salary:** $80,000 – $85,000 per year, plus comprehensive benefits  
**Reports to:** Chief Program Officer  
  
**About Us**  
We are an established San Francisco nonprofit that prepares young people ages 14–24 for the workforce through job-readiness training, paid internships, certifications, and employment connections. Our work centers equity and economic well-being for youth from under-resourced communities.  
  
**The Role**  
The Career and Pathways Program Manager leads several youth programs and supervises the staff who run them. This operations-focused role combines program oversight with hands-on delivery: managing logistics, schedules, partnerships, and deliverables so young people have high-quality experiences. We're looking for a relational leader with strong ties to San Francisco's schools, community organizations, and employers.  
This hybrid role is based in downtown San Francisco. Tuesdays and Thursdays are in-office days, with up to four days a week during peak season (May–August).  
  
**What You'll Do**

* **Manage programs:** Oversee job readiness training, a large summer career exploration program, postsecondary programming, and alumni engagement, including plans, timelines, enrollment, and events.
* **Lead a team:** Supervise program leads, coordinators, and seasonal staff; hire, onboard, coach, and manage performance.
* **Build partnerships:** Manage relationships with employers, training partners, volunteers, and up to five San Francisco public school sites.
* **Shape curriculum:** Refine job readiness and career exploration curriculum, lead a redesign of the job readiness training, and co-design hands-on learning such as field trips, workplace visits, and employer panels.
* **Engage alumni:** Build outreach, events, and support for program alumni, including a cohort of alumni peer leaders.
* **Drive quality:** Use program data to improve outcomes, meet grant requirements, keep documentation accurate, and remove barriers to participation.

  
**What You Bring**  
**Required**

* 5+ years in youth development, education, workforce development, nonprofit management, or a related field
* 3+ years of direct staff supervision and coaching
* Experience managing a program from planning through evaluation, including operations, timelines, and partnerships
* Experience facilitating curriculum and learning activities for young people
* Familiarity with San Francisco's youth-serving, education, and workforce organizations
* Ability to use data to improve outcomes, plus strong written and verbal communication
* Proficiency in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides)
* Commitment to youth-centered practice, equity, and continuous improvement

**Preferred**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; a master's in education, social work, nonprofit management, or a related field
* Experience in youth workforce development, internships, career readiness, or work-based learning
* Experience with Salesforce, Formstack, Canva, or project management tools
* Experience managing grant deliverables and budgets

  
**How to Apply**  
Submit your resume and a cover letter describing your interest and relevant experience. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer**  
We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and strongly encourage people of color, LGBTQ+ individuals, and those with lived experience in under-resourced communities to apply. We comply with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and Chapter 12T of the San Francisco Administrative Code.

jobs.description:
Mountain Engineering is seeking experienced candidates to support PG&E's Pole Clearing Vegetation Team. The Contract Vegetation Program Manager (CVPM) position provides supervisory oversight and expert guidance in line clearance tree pruning and vegetation management in accordance with PG&E's specifications and regulatory requirements.

**Role & Responsibilities**

* Basic areas of responsibility are to assist the VM Program.

* Help support operations and work on process improvement initiatives, schedule, and coordination of VM activities.

* Assist with difficult customers at the direction of the Program Manager (customer complaints, refusals, difficult access, agencies).

* At the direction of the PG&E Representative clarify expectations and program direction for PI and TT contractor employees.

* Assist with monitoring the progress and status of pre-inspection and tree work completion.

* Perform database “sleuthing” to identify issues.

* Assist with agency meetings and field visits to review VM work as directed by the PG&E Program Manager.
* Assist with management of projects – routine and non-routine.
Assist in management of the contract review process.  

  

**Qualifications & Requirements**

* As a supervisory level employee, at a minimum, a CVPM shall have a two-year degree in forestry or a related field, and/or

* Two (2) years’ experience in line clearance tree pruning work or equivalent as determined by the PG&E Representative.

* The CVPM shall exhibit supervisory capabilities and be familiar with the Contractor's work practices, proper arboricultural techniques and practices, proper integrated pest management practices, PG&E's Tree Pruning Specification 5404, Pre-Inspection Specification 4851 and requirements, and all applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

  

The above statements and job description are intended to describe the nature and level of work being performed within this job. They are not intended to be a complete list of all responsibilities, duties, and tasks. Other similar or additional duties are performed as assigned.

  

**Physical Demands**

Sitting for long periods of time working at the computer or driving to job sites. Job site visits require walking on uneven ground, climbing, bending, stooping, and crawling in confined or enclosed spaces. Some lifting of materials and equipment up to 50 lbs. Close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. May work long hours during peak seasons.

**Work Environment**

Typical office environment with adequate temperatures and lighting, low levels of noise. Exposed to the conditions of job sites which can include loud noise, dust, fumes, and extreme weather conditions prevalent at the time. May work various shifts or hours, including early mornings, dusk or evenings.

* Premium Health Coverage for Employee and Dependents (Medical, Dental & Vision)

Individuals seeking accommodations for disabilities are typically required to provide medical documentation supporting the existence of a disability, the need for the accommodation, and what workplace modifications will enable the employee to perform the essential functions of the job.

**POSITION OVERVIEW:**

The Peer Case Manager will help clients navigate reuniting with their families. This will include but is not limited to supporting clients to understand their roles within their family units, strengthen communication, cultivate parenting skills, and foster healthy relationships with their children and/or other family members. Comprehensive case management and peer navigation services will take place via interviews with clients and family members; initial and ongoing assessments will guide linking clients to community providers and resources. The role also includes attending appointments with clients, to support them if they feel overwhelmed; facilitating communication between the client’s probation officer, and helping their probation officer better understand the client’s circumstances and challenges; serving as a role model or example of what is possible; and otherwise, being a safe, supportive resource and advocate for the client. The Peer Case Manager will report directly to the Program Lead. This role will uphold and champion the agency’s mission, vision, and values and contribute to a collaborative, inclusive work culture.

**This position is covered under the SEIU 1021 Collective Bargaining Agreement. In addition to the established base pay, members will receive negotiated annual increases as follows:**

* **January 2027: 3% base pay increase**

**Future increases will be subject to the terms of the collective bargaining agreement.**

* Manage caseloads for clients to provide and track case management and care coordination services, including:
* Develop and maintain rapport with participants and maintain rapport and trust through consistent, regular meetings, including proactively communicating and soliciting updates from participants and consistent use of Motivational Interviewing techniques.
* Must be able to serve as peer mentors or credible messengers, who can establish a deeper level of trust with Participants.
* Must help clients stay engaged and motivated in making progress towards the goals that are articulated.
* Must provide resources and support services that will remove barriers to goals.
* Must track progress towards goals.
* Must be able to support participants as they navigate through their reentry journey.

* Provide outreach engagement, linkage, and follow up services to clients.
* Act as a role model, with the intention of inspiring, engaging, and advocating for client’s wellness and rights.
* Research and provide referral resources for participants in order to help them meet their needs.

* Attend trainings and participate in events relevant to key responsibilities
* Track and regularly report on key metrics for responsible function areas
* Leads and collaborate on special projects related to agency objectives as appropriate

jobs.description:
**About Cardea Health:**

Cardea Health is a non-profit organization dedicated to providing compassionate health care to marginalized populations.

**Misson Statement:**

Our mission is to create and support programs that protect the health and autonomy of vulnerable individuals and promote equity and social justice to improve the well-being of our entire community. Compassionate care for vulnerable populations.

**Workplace Culture:**

Cardea is dedicated to creating a workplace that celebrates diversity and actively seeks to include underrepresented communities. We believe that diversity drives innovation and fosters a more dynamic, inclusive, and productive work environment. We value unique perspectives, experiences, and talents, and we are committed to providing equitable opportunities for growth and advancement. Join us in building a team that reflects the rich diversity of our society and let's make a positive impact together.

Our Cardea CARE(S) Values include:

* Compassion
    
  Big heart, steady presence
* Accountability
    
  We own it: the work, the follow-through, the impact.
* Respect
    
  We assume good intent and keep it real
* Engagement
    
  We lean in and figure it out together.
* Support
    
  We’ve got each other across roles, teams, and sites.

These values guide how we care for residents, collaborate with colleagues, and represent Cardea Health in the community.

**Primary Work Location:** Multiple Interim Housing Sites

This position supports multiple Cardea Health Interim Housing Programs and requires regular travel between assigned locations.

Cardea's interim housing programs provide temporary housing, stabilization services, clinical support, care coordination, case management, and connections to permanent housing opportunities for individuals experiencing homelessness.

Employees in these roles should expect frequent collaboration with residents, healthcare providers, social service agencies, community partners, and multidisciplinary teams.

**Job Summary:**

The Community Health Worker (CHW) is an essential member of Cardea Health’s clinical team, supporting residents of Cardea Health interim housing programs who are enrolled in Behavioral Health Bridge Housing (BHBH). BHBH residents are living with complex medical, behavioral health, and social needs and often require intensive individualized support to reach their clinical and housing goals. The CHW leverages their lived and/or community-based experience to build trust, engage clients in care, and coordinate services that promote health, housing stability, and overall well-being. Working under the direction of the Director of Nursing and in close collaboration with program management and clinical staff, the CHW serves as a bridge between clients, healthcare providers, housing staff, and community resources.

**Client Engagement & Support:**

* Build rapport and maintain trusting relationships with BHBH enrolled residents of interim housing programs
* Conduct outreach and wellness checks to support engagement in behavioral health care and related services
* Assist clients in identifying personal health and life goals and developing action plans to achieve them
* Provide culturally responsive education on health topics, medication adherence, and chronic disease management

**Care Coordination:**

* Collaborate with the interim housing interdisciplinary team, including nursing staff, Substance Use Navigators, and Housing Case Managers to coordinate care and services
* Support care transitions, such as hospital discharges, changes in medical conditions and in housing, or benefits
* Help clients navigate healthcare systems, schedule appointments, arrange transportation, and access benefits or entitlements
* Document client encounters and progress in alignment with Cardea Health standards

**System Navigation & Advocacy:**

* Advocate for client needs within healthcare, housing, and social service systems
* Identify barriers to care and collaborate with the clinical team to problem-solve and reduce those barriers
* Maintain knowledge of community-based services and resources to connect clients effectively

**Program Implementation & Collaboration:**

* Participate in team case conferences, quality improvement activities, and data tracking
* Work collaboratively with site staff to promote integrated and coordinated care delivery
* Uphold Cardea Health’s mission, values, and trauma-informed, harm reduction, and person-centered principles in all interactions.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Experience providing direct support to individuals experiencing homelessness, behavioral health conditions, or chronic illness
* Knowledge of harm reduction, motivational interviewing, and trauma-informed care practices
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build rapport with diverse populations
* Familiarity with community-based resources, public benefits, and housing systems
* Valid California driver’s license or ability to travel to various PSH sites as needed

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Certification as a Community Health Worker or Peer Specialist
* Bilingual in English and Spanish or another language commonly spoken in the community
* Experience working within Medi-Cal ECM, CalAIM, or managed care coordination programs

**Physical Requirements:** This position requires significant mobility and regular presence within program environments.

Essential physical activities may include:
