jobs.title: ERP Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**Role summary**

We have an exciting opportunity for an ERP Implementation Specialist to bring Talon’s newly acquired West Coast manufacturers onto our standard JobBOSS² ERP. You will work alongside Talon’s current ERP Implementation Specialist and the IT Director, taking each shop from spreadsheets, QuickBooks or a legacy ERP to a standardized JobBOSS² environment, and making sure the team actually uses it. This is a hands-on, travel-heavy role: expect to spend 40–60% of your time on-site at shops located on the West Coast, mapping processes on the floor, converting data, training users and supporting go-lives in person.

The role is remote, and you must live on the West Coast (Arizona, California, Nevada, Oregon or Washington) within 30 minutes of a major commercial airport.

**About Talon Precision**

Talon Precision is a group of precision manufacturing shops serving the aerospace and defense, semiconductor, space and medical device end markets. Our customers help keep the world safe, connected, healthy and prosperous. Our mission is to restore manufacturing excellence here at home. Each Talon business operates with its own president and team, supported by a common Talon IT platform, including JobBOSS² as our standard ERP, so our shops can focus on making great parts.

This role is a key part of how newly acquired West Coast businesses join that platform.

**Key responsibilities**

* Carry out full-cycle JobBOSS² implementations: discovery, process mapping, configuration, data migration, testing, training, cutover and post-go-live support.
* Execute conversions from other ERPs (Epicor, Infor and others), including data mapping, cleanup, validation and parallel runs, with minimal disruption to production and shipping.
* Apply and improve Talon’s standard JobBOSS² configuration across quoting, estimating, job costing, scheduling, purchasing, inventory, shipping, quality and accounting integration.
* Work with operations, finance, quality and shipping teams to redesign processes around the standard, not around old workarounds.
* Help assess the ERP and business processes of acquisition targets and estimate integration effort, risk and timeline.
* Maintain project plans and cutover checklists, and report status and risks to the IT Director.
* Train site users and develop super-users who support their teams after go-live.
* Coordinate with outside resources (ECi professional services, conversion consultants) and Talon’s managed service provider to keep work on scope and schedule.
* Ensure ERP data supports consolidated financial and operational reporting across Talon businesses.
* Configure access and handling of ITAR-controlled and CUI data in line with Talon’s CMMC Level 2 program.
* Maintain implementation playbooks, templates and documentation so each new site goes faster than the last.

**Required qualifications**

* 3+ years of ERP implementation or support experience in a manufacturing environment, including hands-on work on at least one full-cycle implementation or conversion.
* Hands-on experience with at least one of: JobBOSS² (ECi), Epicor (Kinetic / E10 / E2 Shop System) or Infor (SyteLine / CloudSuite Industrial, VISUAL).
* Working knowledge of job-shop or make-to-order processes: quoting, estimating, routings, job costing, scheduling, purchasing, inventory, shipping and invoicing.
* Proven data migration skills: extracting, mapping, cleaning and validating data from legacy systems and spreadsheets (strong Excel; SQL a plus).
* Strong training and communication skills, with the credibility to win over shop-floor, front-office and finance users alike.
* Residence on the U.S. West Coast (Arizona, California, Nevada, Oregon or Washington) within 30 minutes of a major commercial airport.
* Willingness to travel 40–60% to sites located on the West Coast, with occasional trips to the East Coast, and to work early, late or weekend hours during cutovers.
* Ability to work on ITAR-controlled programs (U.S. person status required).

**Preferred qualifications**

* JobBOSS² implementation experience.
* Experience converting between ERPs, especially Epicor or Infor to JobBOSS² or similar.
* Experience in aerospace, defense, semiconductor, space or medical precision machining, or similar high-mix, low-volume environments.
* Experience integrating companies after acquisitions, or across multiple sites.
* Familiarity with AS9100, ITAR, DFARS and CMMC requirements as they apply to ERP data and access.
* Experience with QuickBooks or other accounting integrations, Power BI or ERP reporting tools.
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Business, Industrial Engineering or a related field.
* Project management certification (PMP, CAPM) or ERP vendor certification.

Compensation Range: $90K - $120K

* Support the operations organization by ensuring operational data is accurate and users are properly set up across operating systems.

**Job Type: Contract**

We are looking for a proactive, detail-oriented **Office Manager** to serve as the operational backbone and welcoming face of our San Francisco office. jobs.description:
**About Newmark**

Newmark Group, Inc. (Nasdaq: NMRK), together with its subsidiaries (“Newmark”), is a world leader in commercial real estate, seamlessly powering every phase of the property life cycle. Newmark’s comprehensive suite of services and products is uniquely tailored to each client, from owners to occupiers, investors to founders, and startups to blue-chip companies. Combining the platform’s global reach with market intelligence in both established and emerging property markets, Newmark provides superior service to clients across the industry spectrum. For the twelve months ended June 30, 2026, Newmark generated revenues of more than $3.6 billion. As of June 30, 2026, Newmark and its business partners together operated from over 195 offices with more than 10,000 professionals across four continents. To learn more, visit nmrk.com or follow @newmark .

Summary

The Workplace Operations Specialist is a hospitality-minded, energetic professional who helps a client office run smoothly each day through reliable services, well-maintained spaces and engaging workplace programs. Employed by Newmark and supporting a Newmark Occupier Solutions client account onsite (not as an employee of the client), the Specialist reports to Newmark account and workplace leadership and coordinates day to day with the client's
  
workplace stakeholders and partner functions such as IT, Recruiting, People Operations and Finance.

As a visible presence in the office, the Specialist helps bring employee events, engagement initiatives and hospitality programs to life, building relationships, anticipating employee needs and finding creative ways to make each day better. jobs.title: Business Operations Lead
jobs.description:
**The job**
-----------

Enable Honey Homes’ growth by building scalable systems to make each member’s perceived Honey Homes experience exceptional. The long-term metric output is increasing retention and member satisfaction.

This is a new position at Honey Homes, reporting to the CEO and sitting on the Senior Leadership team. Informed by analysis and the broader team’s input, the Business Operations Lead will identify leading indicator metrics that will increase retention and build structural, scalable systems to improve those metrics. Former founders, general managers, consultants, investment bankers, or bizops leaders would thrive in this role.

The scope of this role is intentionally broad to allow for unfettered exploration of impactful work and flexibility in adjusting scope and focus at any time to maximally benefit Honey Homes’ members.

Honey Homes’ mission is to replace the hassle of home upkeep with comfort and joy. This is a hard problem, but a valuable one to tackle. Our work is a complex and intensive journey spanning software, AI, human labor, and consumer preferences. Getting it right unlocks tremendous value for homeowners, and creates thousands of American jobs. We’re a small and mighty team who enjoy working together, backed by top-tier investors.

**Outcomes and Competencies**
-----------------------------

* **12-month Outcomes**

  + **Increase Retention:** Meaningfully lift monthly-cohort renewal rate from Year 1 to Year 2

    - **Every visit is excellent in the member’s eyes:** Every scheduled visit exceeds the members expectations by showing up on time, being prepared, completing tasks, clear communication when the unknown becomes known, and proactive follow up.
    - **Stay connected with members between visits:** Member chats that need a human answer are tackled quickly, and drive improvement of our AI assistant’s capabilities in partnership with Product
    - **Handyman supply is always available:** Recruiting pipeline delivers a hire-ready, vetted handyman in every market ahead of growth needs.
    - **Training sets up new handymen for success:** Rebuild handyman onboarding so each new hire cohort rapidly achieves our quality metrics.
    - **Launch holistic fixes to hit goals:** Solve problems with structural programs that address large swaths of challenges in one go.
    - **Hire teammates to support growth:** Identify what needs focus and support, dive in to understand it, build it, and get someone else (or AI) to own it going forward.
* **Competencies**

  + **You solve problems from first principles.** You’re excited to solve problems in innovative ways, and you resist “this is how it’s always been done” thinking
  + **You prioritize all day long.** You understand what's the most important thing to be working on for the long-term benefit of our members, and make sure it gets done.
  + **You’re unafraid of ambiguity.** Rapid change and learning is exciting to you, and you thrive in ambiguous, startup environments
  + **You’re analytical.** You let data win arguments. You are a data-first problem solver with excellent Excel / data analysis skills.
  + **You document everything.** You build repeatable playbooks that are continually improved. You share clear, concise and frequent updates with your team.
  + **You’re relentless.** You do what it takes to win, no matter what
  + **You’re a proven leader.** You have hired great people in the past, and managed high-performing teams. You effectively collaborate with partners across the company at all levels.
  + **You are passionate about recruiting:** You understand that hiring is a key part of any role, and you foster a culture of always-on recruiting.
  + **You act like an owner.** You do what it takes to support our members throughout the year.
  + **Curious quick study.** When you hear - 1/2" Angle Stop - you ask what that is, and add it to your personal dictionary. Same for processes and ways to solve problems.
  + **You're technical enough.** You use AI to accelerate your work, and expand your impact. You can understand the evolving constraints on building product, and work directly with engineers on new product that directly affects your goals.
  + **You energize others.** Your attitude and leadership brings others with you on the journey every day. You create more leaders with the same zeal that you have.

*We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status.*

jobs.title: Training Manager, AV Operational Safety
jobs.description:
**About the Role:**  
  
We are seeking an experienced Training Program Manager to support the development, implementation, and ongoing management of training programs supporting Uber's Autonomous Mobility & Delivery operations. This role requires a strong understanding of training program development, instructional methodologies, and competency-based assessments, ideally within autonomous vehicles, transportation, or other safety-critical operational environments.  
  
The successful candidate will have experience developing and managing structured training programs that prepare operational staff to safely and effectively perform operational responsibilities. This includes developing training curricula, establishing qualification and certification requirements, implementing recurrent training, and evaluating training effectiveness through measurable performance outcomes.  
  
In this role, you will be responsible for building and maintaining training programs that can be executed by Uber and its external fleet operators and staffing partners. You will work closely with Fleet Operations, Safety, Engineering, and external partners to ensure training reflects vehicle capabilities, operational procedures, and evolving business requirements. This role will also support the qualification of instructors, oversight of training delivery, and continuous improvement of training programs as our deployments with our autonomous vehicle partners expand across markets.  
  
This is a highly cross-functional role requiring strong program management, stakeholder engagement, and the ability to translate complex technical and operational requirements into practical, scalable training solutions.  
  
**What you’ll do:**  

* **Training Program Development**: Develop, implement, and maintain comprehensive training programs for autonomous vehicle operations, including onboarding, classroom instruction, practical evaluations, and recurrent training.
* **Curriculum & Instructional Design**: Create and maintain standardized training materials, instructor guides, learning objectives, assessments, and supporting documentation using established adult learning and instructional design principles.
* **Qualification & Certification**: Establish competency-based assessment criteria and qualification processes to ensure operations staff demonstrate the knowledge, skills, and practical abilities required to perform their responsibilities before being authorized for independent operations.
* **Training Delivery & Partner Oversight**: Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external staffing or fleet operations partners to support consistent execution of training programs, including train-the-trainer initiatives, instructor qualification, and periodic evaluations of training delivery.
* **Training Program Management**: Manage training program implementation across operational sites, coordinating schedules, resources, milestones, and deliverables to support fleet readiness, new market launches, and operational expansion.
* **Training Effectiveness & Continuous Improvement**: Monitor training performance through assessment results, certification outcomes, operations feedback, and operational performance data. Identify opportunities to improve training content, delivery methods, and operator proficiency.

  
**Basic Qualifications:**  

* Minimum of 5 years of experience in designing implementing training programs
* Demonstrated ability to manage training initiatives, coordinate multiple stakeholders, and execute programs against defined timelines and operational objectives.
* Bachelor's degree in Education, Instructional Design, Business Administration, Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  
**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Minimum of 5 years of experience developing, implementing, or managing structured training programs in autonomous vehicles, transportation, automotive, logistics, or other operational environments.
* Direct experience developing or managing training programs for autonomous vehicle operations, test drivers, safety drivers, or other personnel involved in autonomous vehicle testing and operations.
* Experience developing and implementing train-the-trainer programs and overseeing training delivery through third-party vendors or staffing partners.
* Familiarity with training requirements and best practices in safety-critical industries, including automotive, aviation, commercial transportation, or autonomous mobility.
* Experience managing training programs across multiple operational locations, including supporting new site launches and geographically distributed workforces.
* A continuous improvement mindset, with the ability to adapt training programs to evolving technology, operational requirements, and business needs.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience working across cross-functional teams and external partners to implement standardized processes and training requirements.

  
For New York City, NY-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $162,000 per year - USD $180,000 per year.  
  
For San Francisco, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $162,000 per year - USD $180,000 per year.  
  
For all US locations, you will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits.

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.

At **ModMed**, we’re not just building software—we’re reimagining the healthcare experience. **A Culture of Excellence**

When you join ModMed, you’re joining an award-winning team recognized for innovation and employee satisfaction. From our global headquarters in Boca Raton Florida, and extensive employee base in Hyderabad India, we are a team of 4,500+ passionate problem-solvers on a mission to increase medical practice success and improve patient outcomes:

The **Customer Success Specialist** acts as the post-sale consultative partner and trusted advisor to our clients, and is responsible for the ownership and handling of our Account Management escalation queue in Salesforce CRM. The CSS will be held accountable for delivering the appropriate solution/deliverables for each case that is sent to the AM queue, while maintaining a positive customer experience. ------------------------------

* Manages and owns customer needs that come through the Account Management escalation queue in Salesforce.
* Maintain an understanding of client industry, MMI suite of products, and role in the market.
* Work collaboratively with other teams and departments across the organization to improve processes and mitigate customer risk.
* Identify and facilitate upsell opportunities with customers as appropriate.
* Serve as escalation point for issues that impact the customer’s success.
* Advocate customer needs/issues cross departmentally.
* Maintain regular communication (written and verbal) with customer escalations that you are owning.
* Monitor and record all client communication in Salesforce.
* Suggest practical services offered by MMI to create a more efficient and autonomous office flow.
* Potential of owning your own small book of business.

***Skills & Requirements:***
----------------------------

* Bachelor's Degree, preferred.
* 1-2 years of relevant experience or equivalent combination of experience and education.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to navigate and mediate conflict.
* Detailed-oriented and organized.
* Ability to work independently as well as part of the customer success team.
* Professional, patient and balanced approach to handling tasks of varying priority and stress levels.
* Conflict resolution and problem solving skills.
* Ability to take initiative with little direction.
* Empathetic communicator with a consultative approach - able to see things from another person’s point of view.
* Working knowledge of Salesforce and Gainsight is a plus.
* Ability to multi-task and shift focus/priorities on-the-fly in a fast paced environment.
* People skills - you must be comfortable on the phone and able to engage in/control difficult discussions while maintaining professional composure.
* Motivated - we are a growing and ever-changing organization that is transforming how healthcare information is created, consumed and utilized to increase practice efficiency and improve patient outcomes.

***ModMed Benefits Highlight:*** At ModMed, we believe it’s important to offer a competitive benefits package designed to meet the diverse needs of our growing workforce. Eligible Modernizers can enroll in a wide range of benefits:

**United States**

* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits, including a company Health Savings Account contribution,
* 401(k): ModMed provides a matching contribution each payday of 50% of your contribution deferred on up to 6% of your compensation. After one year of employment with ModMed, 100% of any matching contribution you receive is yours to keep.
* Generous Paid Time Off and Paid Parental Leave programs,
* Company paid Life and Disability benefits, Flexible Spending Account, and Employee Assistance Programs,
* Company-sponsored Business Resource & Special Interest Groups that provide engaged and supportive communities within ModMed,
* Professional development opportunities, including tuition reimbursement programs and unlimited access to LinkedIn Learning,
* Global presence and in-person collaboration opportunities; dog-friendly HQ (US), Hybrid office-based roles and remote availability for some roles,
* Weekly catered breakfast and lunch, treadmill workstations, Zen, and wellness rooms within our BRIC headquarters.

**PHISHING SCAM WARNING:** ModMed is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving imposters posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote "interviews," and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. ### **Company Introduction:**

Airspace is a tech-enabled freight forwarder that's redefining how the world's most critical packages are delivered. Headquartered in Carlsbad, California, Airspace has employees who are based around the world. Our European headquarters is in Amsterdam, The Netherlands.

As a recognized leader in AI and machine learning, our team leverages data and patented technology to coordinate logistics across a global network of drivers and airlines. Our goal is to deliver those packages that are truly mission-critical in a way that is faster, more transparent, more secure, and more accountable than ever before. The items we deliver range from organs for transplant, to parts for critical machinery including grounded aircraft and highly sensitive components such as semiconductors.

Airspace has been rated one of America's best Startup Employers and listed as one of CNBC's Disruptor 50 companies. Airspace has the support of leading investors such as Telstra Ventures, HarbourVest Partners, Defy Partners, DBL Partners, and Scale Ventures. To date the company has raised more than $140m.

The company is growing rapidly and serving more places around the world than ever before. We are looking for passionate, motivated individuals who want to make an IMPACT every day to help us execute on our mission of reshaping the world of time-critical logistics.

**Own the Judgment Calls That Keep Orders Moving**
--------------------------------------------------

Every shipment eventually hits a moment that isn't in the SOP — a failed carrier connection, an oversized load with no obvious coverage, a customer who needs a straight answer under pressure. As an Operations Specialist II, you're the person who resolves that moment without waiting for someone else to tell you how.

You've mastered the OS I fundamentals and are now trusted to act on incomplete information, source coverage other people can't, and de-escalate situations independently. This is where reactive execution starts becoming proactive ownership.

  

**What You'll Do**
------------------

*Must be able to perform all responsibilities included in the Operations Specialist I job description, in addition to the following:*

### **Resolve What Doesn't Fit the Standard Playbook**

* Independently start carrier traces for failed-to-load or unable-to-locate shipments
* Source driver coverage for any segment of an order, including oversized shipments
* Use bid/quote request tools to source specialized vehicles and provide cost estimates to customers
* Apply training and tenured knowledge to anticipate complications and proactively solve for them

### **Exercise Independent Judgment**

* De-escalate most situations without assistance
* Know when to escalate an order versus independently resolving it using available resources
* Understand the downstream impact of decisions made within an order

### **Communicate Proactively and Strengthen the Platform**

* Communicate proactively — not just reactively — with customers, drivers, and agents at every step of the shipment process
* Maintain any certifications required for your assigned sector and stay current on related compliance requirements
* Identify and suggest system features or workflow improvements that would help Operations

### **Maintain a Balanced Level of Performance**

As an OS II, you'll be expected to meet minimum metric requirements and customer service standards appropriate for this level. Specific metrics vary by sector and will be communicated by your direct reporting supervisor. Expectations increase with each advancement.

  

**Requirements**
----------------

* Demonstrated success as an Operations Specialist I, or equivalent time-critical logistics / customer operations experience
* Proven ability to make sound decisions with incomplete information and under time pressure
* Track record of de-escalating difficult customer or operational situations without needing to hand it off
* Comfort sourcing non-standard solutions (specialized vehicles, oversized loads) rather than defaulting to escalation
* Any certifications required for your assigned sector (e.g., Dangerous Goods handling, where applicable), or willingness to obtain them
* Continued availability to work the shift pattern required by your team

  

**Advancement to Operations Specialist III**
--------------------------------------------

To advance to OS III, you'll need to demonstrate all of the following:

* Minimum of 6-12 months in the OS II role
* Consistently meeting or exceeding OS II performance standards, tracked through ongoing 1:1 check-ins and confirmed across two consecutive Semi-Annual Reviews (SARs)
* Demonstrated advanced problem-solving proficiency — independently resolving escalations rather than routing them upward
* Working understanding of margin and cost tradeoffs as they relate to order decisions
* Manager recommendation, confirming readiness to operate as an escalation point for the team

#### **About us**

Coalition is the world's first Active Insurance provider designed to help prevent digital risk before it strikes. Founded in 2017, Coalition combines comprehensive insurance coverage and innovative cybersecurity tools to help businesses manage and mitigate potential cyberattacks.

Opportunities to make an impact with bold thinking are real—and happening daily at Coalition.

#### **About the role**

Coalition's Claims Operations team is the first step in every claim. Before a handler can work a file, we set it up, route it and make sure the insured and broker hear from us quickly.

The Claims Operations Associate keeps that front door running across every line of business and every country we serve. You'll handle intake, claim setup and payments at high volume, and you'll help us test and adopt the automation that will change how this work gets done.

You'll work closely with claims handlers and managers, brokers, policyholders and our vendor partners. This role reports to the Senior Manager, Claims Operations.

#### **Responsibilities**

### **Intake and claim setup**

* Serve as a first point of contact by email and phone for brokers and policyholders reporting incidents, giving them confidence their claim is in good hands;
* Set up new claims across all lines of business and countries, ensuring data accuracy and routing each claim to the right handler;
* Send acknowledgement letters, claim summaries and notice letters, and keep claim records complete from day one;
* Answer and route claims hotline calls and triage the claims inbox;

### **Payments and reporting**

* Process and review claim payments with a focus on accuracy;
* Produce loss runs and respond to broker requests;
* Keep operational trackers current, including vendor progress and payment accuracy;

### **Across the role**

* Maintain key team records such as authority letters, licensing and quality review file pulls;
* Test new tools and automation before rollout, including AI, and give feedback that makes them better;
* Become a subject matter expert in our claims processes and systems; and
* Spot what slows the team down and recommend improvements as we grow.

#### **Skills and Qualifications**

* 3+ years of experience in claims or insurance operations
* Strong working knowledge of Salesforce or a similar claims or CRM system
* Attention to detail and accuracy, especially when working at high volume;
* Professional communication via phone and email, including on urgent or stressful claims
* Self starter mentality who takes ownership of the work and follows it through without waiting to be asked;
* Highly organized, able to juggle a steady flow of daily new claims, payments and requests
* Comfortable with new tools and changing processes with a curiosity for how automation and AI can improve workflows
* Experience with cyber or specialty lines claims is a plus

#### **Compensation**

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several US geographic markets. The US base salary for this position ranges from $55,000/year in our lowest geographic market up to $85,000/year in our highest geographic market. Consistent with applicable laws, an employee's pay within this range is based on a number of factors, which include but are not limited to relevant education, skills, job-related knowledge, qualifications, work experience, credentials, and/or geographic location. Your recruiter can share more on target salary for your location during the interview process. Coalition, Inc. reserves the right to modify this range as needed.

#### **Perks**

* 100% medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k) retirement plan with competitive employer match
* Flexible PTO
* Up to 14 weeks of paid leave for birthing parents and 8 weeks of paid parental leave for non-birthing parents
* Annual home office stipend and WeWork access
* Mental & physical health wellness programs like One Medical, Headspace, Wellhub, and more!
* Competitive compensation and opportunity for advancement

#### **Why Coalition?**

Work at Coalition is centered on the joint mission to Protect the Unprotected. We have built a remote-first, highly inclusive culture that welcomes people from diverse backgrounds. We trust each other to take responsibility, share ownership of outcomes, and put in the work together to protect businesses from digital risk. Coalition's exceptional growth stems from its ability to address real-world problems for organizations of all sizes while remaining true to our founding values of character, humility, responsibility, purpose, authenticity, and inclusion.

We're always looking for collaborative, inquisitive individuals to join #OurCoalition.

Visit our Newsroom >

Coalition is committed to protecting your privacy and handling your personal information responsibly. We collect, use, and store personal information as necessary for the recruitment process and in compliance with applicable privacy laws and regulations in all regions where we operate. We want you to understand what personal information we collect, how we use it, and your rights regarding access, correction, and deletion of your data where applicable. Information submitted, collected, and processed as part of your application is subject to Coalition's Privacy Policy. For further details, please review our full Privacy Policy or contact us with any questions regarding how your information is handled.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
**About Willow Health**
-----------------------

In the United States, one in five adults experience a mental health illness and over 12 million people have thoughts of suicide. Mental health crises can be some of the most difficult times in a person’s life, and over 17 million people seeking behavioral health care experience a delay in accessing care. Willow Health is on a mission to significantly improve this experience by expanding affordable access to high-quality, evidence-based intensive behavioral health care. In order to make this mission a reality, we deliver a virtual, urgent crisis care program that provides personalized, recovery-oriented care for people experiencing behavioral health crises.

Willow Health offers patients immediate access to evidence-based virtual crisis psychotherapy, medication management, certified peer coaching, care management, and around the clock crisis coverage, while working to connect patients to the most appropriate next level of care.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

Willow Health has launched its virtual behavioral health program in North Carolina and is preparing to open an in-person location where patients can see a clinician virtually. This role will lead implementation of the physical site and manage ongoing operational workstreams, including partner reporting and invoicing requirements.

A substantial part of the role will involve working closely with the Joint Operating Committee consultant to coordinate site readiness, track deliverables, and resolve implementation challenges. This person will also collaborate with our Community Partnerships Manager, who owns ongoing partner relationship management and outreach.

### **Key Responsibilities**

### **1. Project Leadership & Implementation**

* In-Person Site Launch: Manage the implementation plan for Willow’s North Carolina location, including milestones, dependencies, responsibilities, and launch readiness.
* Consultant Coordination: Work closely with the Joint Operating Committee consultant to align priorities, track deliverables, and coordinate decisions and follow-through across internal and external stakeholders.
* Cross-Functional Execution: Coordinate with Clinical, Operations, Technology, Legal, and Finance teams to complete launch activities and ongoing implementation projects.
* Issue Resolution: Proactively identify blockers, coordinate solutions, and escalate decisions that require leadership input.
* Leadership Updates: Provide concise weekly updates on progress, risks, upcoming milestones, and decisions needed.

### **2. Partner Reporting & Invoicing**

* Requirements Management: Maintain a centralized calendar of all reporting and invoicing obligations for partner organizations, including deadlines, required documentation, and submission processes.
* Reporting: Own the preparation, validation, and timely submission of required reports, including utilization, program outcomes, and patient satisfaction reporting.
* Invoicing: Coordinate with Finance to prepare and submit accurate invoices and supporting documentation on time.
* Budget Monitoring: Track program expenses, revenue, and funding utilization against contractual budgets, flagging discrepancies or risks to leadership.

### **3. Technology & Systems Improvement**

* Requirements Translation: Translate evolving operational and partner requirements into actionable tasks for Technology and Operations teams.
* Workflow Improvement: Continuously refine patient intake, referral, scheduling, and communication workflows based on patient, clinician, and partner feedback.
* Process Documentation: Maintain clear procedures and resources to support consistent execution and ongoing improvements.

### **4. Regulatory & Compliance Coordination**

* Requirements Tracking: Work with Legal, Clinical, and Operations teams to track applicable filings, licenses, approvals, and other requirements for the physical site and ongoing program.
* Documentation: Coordinate completion and submission of required materials, ensuring appropriate internal review and approval.
* Record Keeping: Maintain a centralized repository of contracts, approvals, compliance documents, and related deadlines.

### **5. Program Monitoring & Operational Improvement**

* Performance Monitoring: Track program metrics, including referrals, intakes, completed appointments, patient engagement, no-shows, and cancellations.
* Operational Follow-Up: Identify gaps or trends and coordinate with the appropriate team to address them.
* Implementation Support: Collaborate with the Community Partnerships Manager on referral workflows, partner onboarding needs, and operational issues that require additional support.
* Continuous Improvement: Develop repeatable processes that improve efficiency and support program growth.

### **Qualifications**

* Project Management: Experience coordinating complex implementation or operational projects, preferably in health care.
* Organization: Ability to manage multiple workstreams, deadlines, and stakeholders with strong attention to detail.
* Reporting & Financial Coordination: Experience compiling reports, coordinating invoices and supporting documentation, and tracking budgets or contractual requirements.
* Communication: Ability to translate operational needs into clear action items and communicate progress, risks, and decisions to internal teams and external stakeholders.
* Initiative: Comfortable working remotely and independently, prioritizing effectively within the weekly commitment.
* Travel: Ability to travel to the North Carolina location as needed.

### **Success Measures**

* Implementation Delivery: Meeting agreed milestones for the in-person location and ongoing projects.
* Reporting & Invoicing Accuracy: Submitting complete, accurate reports and invoices within required deadlines.
* Operational Readiness: Ensuring critical workflows, systems, and required approvals are in place before the site opens.

jobs.title: Sprint Pod Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Pathways 2 Solutions, Inc. (Pathways) is a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business helping government and commercial clients turn complex challenges into practical solutions. Our capabilities span strategic communications, technology, training, program management, and organizational improvement. We bring together experienced professionals who combine creative thinking with disciplined execution to help clients achieve measurable results.  
  
We help clients develop programs, introduce new technologies, engage stakeholders, and equip people with the knowledge and resources to succeed. Our work with the Department of Veterans Affairs supports initiatives that improve the Veteran experience. We welcome professionals who bring sound judgment, fresh ideas, and a commitment to delivering useful, reliable work.

**Position Overview**
=====================

The Sprint Pod Project Coordinator provides day-to-day project coordination and operational support to a multidisciplinary team supporting VA’s Digital and Remote Health Center for Innovation. The Project Coordinator provides the organizational structure and dependable follow-through needed for effective sprint pod operations.  
Working under the direction of the Pod Lead, the Coordinator keeps schedules, task boards, meeting records, deliverable trackers, and project documentation accurate and current. The role helps innovation, implementation, technical, communications, and evaluation personnel stay coordinated as they support digital and remote health initiatives. The position translates approved plans and team decisions into maintained schedules, documented actions, organized records, and clear status information.  
  
This is a support position with no formal supervisory responsibility. The Coordinator helps the team maintain visibility into its work, identifies gaps and overdue actions, and brings issues to the Pod Lead for resolution.

**Duties and Responsibilities**
===============================

* Develops and maintains the standard tools and templates for pod use across all projects.
* Runs the pod's sprint mechanics — cadence, tracking, action capture, and follow-through — and maintains the record of acceptance criteria agreed at the start of each sprint.
* Compiles pod velocity data and support the Pod Lead in reporting against the ±15% tolerance.
* Supports development of Project Charters and Project Plans for assigned projects.
* Produces project-level change management, communications, and training support materials in coordination with the program-level Communications Specialist and Training Plan Specialist.
* Coordinates onboarding of innovators and pilot teams to the DRHCI process, using the pilot team guidebook.
* Maintains the project central repository content for assigned projects — documentation, FAQs, templates, and contact points.
* Coordinates meeting and workshop logistics for the pod, including with innovators, vendors, and site participants.
* Maintains project phase tracking inputs and supports the shared tracking system with DHO.
* Supports pod reporting to the DRHCI Program Manager and to VA, assembling status inputs from across the pod.

**Leadership and Collaboration Expectations**
=============================================

The Coordinator is expected to be proactive, tactful, organized, and dependable. Success requires asking clear questions, maintaining accurate records, following up respectfully, and communicating concerns early.  
The position supports the Pod Lead and team members by coordinating information and activities. Project priorities, task commitments, staffing decisions, scope changes, and final deliverable approvals remain with designated leadership and authorized personnel.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Three or more years in project coordination or project support on client-facing delivery teams.
* Demonstrated experience running the mechanics of a sprint or iterative delivery cadence tracking, status, action follow-through, and documentation.
* Experience developing and maintaining standard templates and tools that other people use consistently.
* Experience producing communications or training support materials for a project audience.
* Strong organizational skills and written communication; reliable follow-through without prompting.
* Ability to obtain a VA background investigation or public trust determination.
* Ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders in a client-facing environment.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365, including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and SharePoint.
* Ability to learn and maintain approved project tracking platforms.
* Ability to work independently within established priorities while recognizing when questions or decisions require escalation.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Experience supporting agile, sprint-based, Kanban, or comparable team workflows.
* Familiarity with backlogs, work-item estimates, sprint progress reporting, and review or retrospective activities.
* Experience supporting healthcare innovation, digital health, telehealth, remote monitoring, or technology implementation projects.
* Experience coordinating deliverable review and approval processes.
* Familiarity with project tracking tools such as Microsoft Planner, Jira, Azure DevOps, Smartsheet, or comparable platforms.
* Experience supporting distributed teams, multiple implementation sites, or government stakeholders.
* Experience supporting VA, another federal healthcare organization, or Veteran-facing programs.
* Relevant project management or agile training.

**Credentials and VA Experience**
=================================

No professional certification or prior VA experience is required.  
Relevant training or certification in implementation science, project management, change management, human-centered design, Lean Six Sigma, or quality improvement is preferred.

jobs.title: Program Manager – Federal Mortality Health Data Coding
jobs.description:
**About the role**

Akicita Federal, a tribally owned SBA 8(a) federal contractor, is pursuing a Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) contract supporting the National Center for Health Statistics (NCHS) National Vital Statistics System. The contract delivers manual ICD-10 cause-of-death coding for mortality and fetal death records that cannot be coded by NCHS's automated system. We are seeking a Program Manager to lead a remote team of nosologists (mortality coders) and serve as the primary point of contact for the CDC Contracting Officer and COR.

*This position is contingent upon contract award. Selected candidates will be named in our proposal as Key Personnel.*

**Responsibilities**

* Serve as Project Director with decision-making authority for contract performance; primary liaison to the CDC Contracting Officer and COR
* Lead transition-in within one week of award: onboarding, PIV card processing, government-furnished laptop issuance, MedCoder system access, and required NCHS training
* Recruit, schedule, supervise, and retain a distributed part-time coding team; manage replacements to keep continuity of service
* Track monthly production against purchased record volumes (minimum 16,500 records/month in the base year; 25,000–45,000 expected) and per-coder error rates (< 4%)
* Coordinate quality review batches (2-week turnaround) and validation coding for the automated coding system (1-week turnaround)
* Manage the staff roster, background investigations, Designated Agent Agreements, confidentiality training certificates, and security/privacy compliance
* Oversee timekeeping and payroll inputs in compliance with the Service Contract Labor Standards; support monthly invoicing by accepted record
* Prepare monthly status reports and resolve performance issues

**Required qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree (health information management, public health, business, or related field), or equivalent experience
* 5+ years managing federal contracts or production teams, including at least 3 years leading remote or distributed staff
* Experience managing quality and productivity metrics for coding, abstraction, data-entry, or similar production work

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us**

Snappy Kraken is a marketing program leader in the financial services industry.

**We believe that our work helps people achieve greater freedom.**

* Our tools help financial advisors achieve greater freedom over their time.
* Our content helps people achieve greater financial freedom for their families.
* Our culture helps team members achieve greater freedom in where (and how) to live and work.

**Our innovative solutions set us apart.**

* Financial content is stale; we make it interesting.
* Marketing technology is complex; we make it simple.
* Financial advisor brands are bland; we make them captivating.

**The Purpose of This Role**
----------------------------

The **Rev Ops Manager** is a full-time, remote position at Snappy Kraken. *Accessibility requirements are dependent on the role but could be expected during standard business hours Monday through Friday.* This position is open to any candidates currently residing and eligible to legally work in the United States or Canada.

RevOps is a force multiplier at Snappy Kraken. When it works, people spend their time on the right conversations, risks show up early, and leadership trusts the numbers in front of them.

This is a generalist, hands-on RevOps role. You'll administer HubSpot and support the systems, data and reporting the team runs on.

We’re looking for someone who is curious. When a number doesn't add up, you can't leave it alone until you know why. You like a good puzzle: tracing a broken workflow back to its source, figuring out why a report and someone's gut disagree, untangling a setup nobody documented, following the numbers to recommend what growth levers to pull.

You also care about the people on the other side of the system. A clean routing rule matters because it gets someone to the right buyer faster. A good dashboard matters because a manager can coach from it. You measure your work by the team’s success.

**Reports to:** Head of Revenue Operations and Retail Sales

**Works closely with:** Teams across go-to-market, finance, leadership

**Primary Role & Responsibilities**
-----------------------------------

**Administer HubSpot**

* Serve as admin for the HubSpot portal: users, permissions, properties, pipelines and objects.
* Build and maintain workflows, sequences, lists and automation, and know why each one exists.
* Manage integrations between HubSpot and the rest of the stack. When a sync breaks, you're the one who finds out why.
* Document what you change and why, so the next person can follow your thinking.

**Support the teams leveraging Hubspot and its connected systems.**

* Maintain lead routing and assignment so every lead lands with the right person.
* Keep lifecycle stages, statuses and handoffs between teams working smoothly.
* Support attribution, territory and quota work with clean data and clear logic.
* Ensure clean customer data flows smoothly between all systems including Chargebee, Snappy Kraken, Hubspot, and others.

**Turn data into answers**

* Build and maintain dashboards and reports across the go-to-market funnel.
* Prepare recurring reporting for forecast calls and team reviews.
* Dig into the why behind a trend and bring a recommendation, not just a chart.

**Keep the data clean**

* Own day-to-day data hygiene: deduplication, standardization, enrichment and record ownership.
* Follow and help improve data standards across the CRM.
* Hunt down root causes. Fixing the record is good; fixing what created the bad record is better.

**Put AI and automation to work**

* Use HubSpot Breeze, Clay and Zapier to automate manual work and enrich data.
* Try new AI tools, measure what they actually save, and keep what earns its place.

**Help projects land**

* Run RevOps projects and support cross-functional ones from build through rollout.
* Sit with the people who use the system to understand how they really work before you build for them.
* Share what changed and train the team on new tools and processes.

**Primary Qualifications**
--------------------------

**The kind of person who thrives here**

* You ask "why" a lot, and you keep asking until the answer actually makes sense.
* You'd rather dig into a messy problem than work around it.
* You get genuine satisfaction from making someone else's job easier.
* You can explain a technical fix in plain words to whoever needs to hear it.

**Experience**

* 2–4 years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations or another go-to-market ops role, ideally in B2B SaaS.
* Hands-on HubSpot administration experience.
* A working understanding of the full go-to-market funnel, from first touch through renewal.
* Experience building dashboards and reports people actually use.
* Practical AI proficiency: you use AI tools regularly and have built real workflows with them.
* Familiarity with tools like Zapier, Clay and HubSpot Breeze.
* Experience cleaning and maintaining CRM data.
* Organized enough to run a project and keep people in the loop.
* HubSpot certifications.
* Experience with billing systems, call recording tools or data enrichment tools.
* Comfort with SQL, advanced spreadsheets or a BI tool.
* Experience in financial services or wealth management.
* Experience working in project management tools.

**Perks & Benefits**

* Work Remotely
* Personal Days for when you need a break (on top of your regular vacation)
* Development Fund to help you grow
* Medical Insurance Options
* Parental/Maternity Leave
* Growth opportunities

As of November 2026, the expected compensation range for this position is **$80,000-120,000 USD/ $80,000-120,000 CAD** based on country of residence. Pay will be based on several factors, such as experience, certifications, location, market conditions, and other business and organizational needs. Snappy Kraken anticipates that the reasonably expected salary for this position could change in the future and retains the right to change or revisit the salary range according to business needs.

We’re looking for a **Campaign Operations Manager** to own the operational backbone of campaign execution on our B2B Revenue Operations team. jobs.title: Regional Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**POSITION SUMMARY:**

The Regional Operations Manager leads the performance of a group of manufactured housing communities. The role coaches Community Managers, protects resident satisfaction and property standards, and delivers occupancy, revenue, expense, and sales results for the region.

This is a new regional seat on the Operations team, released from hold. The assigned region will be confirmed at hiring.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Operational Leadership**

* Supervise, coach, and evaluate Community Managers and on-site teams across the region.
* Conduct regular property visits and inspections to confirm curb appeal, safety, maintenance, and resident service standards.
* Oversee lot and home inventory, home readiness, and turn times, and drive each community toward full occupancy.
* Oversee vendor performance, capital and infrastructure projects, and emergency and severe weather readiness.

**Financial Performance**

* Prepare annual community operating budgets with Community Managers and the finance team, building the occupancy, rent, sales, expense, and capital assumptions for each community; recommend final budgets for approval; and manage variances to budget.
* Monitor rent collection and delinquency and direct payment plans, notices, and evictions in coordination with company counsel.
* Review monthly financial statements with Community Managers and drive corrective action.
* Set and track monthly sales, leasing, and occupancy targets for each community.

**People and Culture**

* Participate in recruiting, hiring, onboarding, and training of on-site staff in partnership with Human Resources.
* Promote a culture of accountability, safety, and resident-centered service.
* Document performance concerns and coordinate corrective action with Human Resources.

**Compliance and Reporting**

* Ensure compliance with Fair Housing, landlord-tenant, ADA, and state and local regulations.
* Confirm licenses, permits, registrations, and inspections are current for each community.
* Report incidents, injuries, and property damage promptly and prepare regional reports for the VP of Operations.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor degree preferred, or equivalent experience.
* Five or more years of property management experience, including multi-site oversight, required. Manufactured housing experience strongly preferred.
* Experience supervising managers, including hiring, coaching, and documenting performance, required.
* CPM, CAM, MCM, or similar certification is a plus.
* Demonstrated sales or leasing results, including meeting a quota, preferred.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Strong leadership and coaching skills.
* Financial acumen, including budgeting, delinquency management, and expense control.
* Knowledge of property management software such as Yardi, Rent Manager, or AppFolio.
* Working knowledge of Fair Housing laws and landlord-tenant regulations in the states served.
* Ability to manage multiple sites and priorities.
* Willingness to hold difficult conversations, including delinquency, rule violations, and employment decisions.

**Requirements**

* Valid driver license and reliable transportation. Must meet company insurability standards and a motor vehicle record check is required.
* Employment is contingent on satisfactory completion of a background screening.
* Must complete company-required Fair Housing, safety, and anti-harassment training as assigned.
* Regular overnight travel within the region and availability for emergencies after hours.

**Physical Requirements & Working Conditions**

* Ability to walk properties and inspect homes and lots regularly.
* Must be able to lift up to 25 pounds occasionally.
* Work is performed in communities, in vehicles, and in an office, in varying weather conditions.
* Standard hours are 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, Monday through Friday, with flexibility for site needs.

**COMPENSATION, BENEFITS:**

* Position type: full-time, salaried, exempt.
* Pay: base salary based on experience and qualifications.
* Annual bonus target of 10 percent of base, based on regional results.
* Benefits: medical, dental, and vision; paid time off; paid holidays; and retirement plan.

**COMPANY:**

Everabode Property Management LLC (EPM) is a newly established property management company focused on operating and enhancing manufactured housing communities across multiple states. Backed by a longstanding real estate firm with deep expertise in the manufactured housing industry, we offer both the entrepreneurial excitement of building a company from the ground up and the stability of experienced industry leadership.

At EPM, we are committed to:

* Resident-Centered Service – creating communities where residents feel valued and supported.
* Operational Excellence – ensuring efficiency, compliance, and high performance across our portfolio.
* Growth & Innovation – expanding our footprint while modernizing community management.

*Joining EPM means helping shape our culture and future success during this foundational phase. It’s a unique opportunity to take on meaningful responsibility, grow your career, and play a central role in building something new, with the resources and backing of a proven leader in the manufactured housing industry.*

**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & DISCLOSURES:**

Everabode Property Management LLC is an equal opportunity employer. EPM does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran or military status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply.

EPM complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act and applicable state law and provides reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities during the application process and in employment.

Our goal is sustained employment for career seekers, real results for employers, and stronger communities. jobs.title: Project Manager - Media
jobs.description:
**About Diversified:**  
Diversified is a global leader in audiovisual and media technology. We design and build innovative spaces and experiences for clients across industries such as corporate, entertainment, sports, retail, and government. Our team partners with organizations around the world to create environments that connect people through technology.
  
  
**What to Expect:**  
At Diversified, you’ll work on exciting and complex projects with opportunities to grow your career. We offer a collaborative and flexible work environment, competitive pay and benefits, and a culture that values diversity, inclusion, and innovation. If you’re ready to grow, create, and make an impact, Diversified is the place to do it.
  
  
**How You’ll Contribute:**  
Project manager (PM) is responsible for the scope, schedule, cost, quality and client satisfaction of a project throughout its entire lifecycle, from Initiating through Closing phases. However, the PM depends on the help of other people to perform most of the actual activities of the project. A project manager’s role is primarily focused around written and verbal communication to all project stakeholders.
  
  
The PM is responsible for overseeing, and performing project management functions on all M&E projects, budgets and scopes. The PM will act as the person responsible on their assigned projects and have direct control over all project activities.
  
  
**What You’ll Do:**  
**Primary Duties and Responsibilities:**  

* Daily activities include project communications, scheduling, task lists for technicians, managing deliverables from engineering, CAD and Programming and overseeing the completion of projects. The PM is responsible for completing systems integration projects on time, on budget and achieving high customer satisfaction from our customers. The majority of this employee's time will be spent managing projects and communicating with all project stakeholders. This person will be helping to constantly improve the established Diversified processes.
* As the primary interface to the client, the project manager develops a strong long-term relationship. He manages the client relationship, including expectations, communications and satisfaction.
* Coordinates and communicates.
* Provides clear leadership and ownership for the project within Diversified, including accurate and timely verbal and written communication and follow up.
* Coordinates all activities associated with the timely, accurate and on-budget completion of the project, including engaging stakeholders, delegating responsibilities clearly and running client and internal project meetings.
* Provides support and assistance to team members as needed in order help them be successful and get the job done.
* Ensures appropriate and frequent communication between stakeholders. Resolves destructive conflict.
* Designs, plans, and coordinates work teams with regard to M&E installation projects.
* Assumes ownership of individual projects and assignments.
* Establishes and maintains communication with Account Executives, Directors, installation technicians, subcontractors, clients, etc.
* Develops and communicates project updates as required.
* Provides constant monitoring of labor, equipment and materials budgets.
* Provides and/or directs technical and administrative support to project team members.
* Develops and maintains all related project schedules.
* Performs field verification of prospective work site. Documents all issues with site and keeps everyone informed of potential issues and solutions.
* Coordinates all drawings and documentation between all internal and external stakeholders.
* Facilitates and directs design reviews to assure proper documentation in the field.
* Coordinates all system programming and final checkout of systems. Provides punch-list of remaining tasks after substantial completion.
* Contracts with contractors and other trades when necessary.
* Monitors status of projects including cost, timing and staffing to ensure timely and accurate completion of projects.
* Ensures quality and continuous improvement.
* Coordinates training & turnover of projects to client, service department, & sales.

**Complexity:**  

* Every project is different, and every set of project stakeholders is different. The PM needs to negotiate a very complex set of variables between system design, site conditions and a widely varying set of expectations with multiple stakeholders. The skill of communicating both verbally and in writing to manage all these variables takes a very high level of awareness, emotional intelligence and people management skills. The PM is constantly managing the forces of change in every project environment. Balancing schedules, budgets, scope, quality and client satisfaction are a very complex set of variables.

**Decision Making Authority:**  

* Takes full ownership of project.
* Acts as the single point of responsibility and accountability for the project.
* Ensures schedule performance, quality of solution delivered to client, and client satisfaction.
* Manages and reports on the project’s financials, including ensuring budget performance and profitability. Ensures timely and correct billings to client.
* Demonstrates proactivity, responsiveness, and follow through.
* Communicates decision options to stakeholders and manages those decisions.
* Manages a complex array of decisions at every point of the project but is rarely the sole decision maker.

•

**What you’ll be doing:**

As a Project Manager for ConXtech, you’ll:

* Coordinate design and pre-construction services with applicable departments (i.e., estimating, scheduling, project planning, constructability, site utilization, etc.)
* Manage and facilitate the collaborative design and integration of the ConXtech system with architects, engineers, consultants, contractors, and other sub trades insuring adequate and efficient interface.

* Evaluate project progress and construction practices to ensure budgetary and company goals are achieved via KPI tracking and reporting.

**Who we are:**

ConXtech is a construction technology company based in the San Francisco Bay Area. Our innovative structural steel building systems enable structures to be designed, fabricated and erected faster and safer than any conventional alternative. The ConX System is the chassis inside over 15 million square feet of healthcare, data center, commercial, high density residential and industrial structures. ConXtech works at the leading edge of the construction industry, introducing manufacturing methods and new approaches to increase efficiency, quality and safety throughout the design-to-delivery process.

**What we can offer you:**

Our employees are our biggest asset, and we want to make sure we continue to create a culture that is engaging, inspiring and rewarding to our team. We offer our team members a range of benefits, rewards, health insurance options, PTO and a 401(k) program with employer match.

Our environment embraces those who are self-starters and go-getters. Is that you? Apply!

We are looking for local candidates only. U.S. Citizens and those authorized to work in the U.S. are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor at this time.

ConXtech is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer.

Job Type: Full-time, Exempt

Pay Range: $130K – $160K per year; subject to location.

**Who you are:**

ConXtech is seeking an experienced construction management professional who is passionate about managing and being the single point of contact for assigned ConXtech projects that consist of structural steel modular building frames. You enjoy being responsible for the entire project from design development to final project closeout. You are focused on goals that include completing projects safely, on schedule and on budget with ConXtech’s required level of quality and customer satisfaction.

**You have:**

* A Bachelor’s degree (preferably in Construction Management or Engineering) or equivalent experience.
* A minimum of 5 years’ experience in the structural steel construction industry.
* An understanding of commercial construction processes.
* Strong problem-solving skills with hands-on field experience.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills and the ability to effectively function as a team.
* Leadership abilities with qualities required to effectively manage several direct reports.
* Ability and self-confidence to make key decisions, with self-awareness to consult guidance when needed.
* Excellent time management skills and the ability to work on multiple projects.
* Strong negotiation skills.
* Proficiency in leveraging AI platforms for daily workflow.
* Proficient modeling and detailing experience with Tekla Structures (preferably v20.0 & v2019i).
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office & Microsoft Teams (remote working).
* Competence in the following software tools:
  + Procore (construction Admin- document control)
  + Sage (accounting data)
  + Revit, Tekla, AutoCAD and SketchUp
  + BlueBeam
* Experience with scheduling software preferred, e.g., Microsoft Project, Primavera, etc.
* Ability to travel to project sites as needed.

This role will work closely with internal estimating teams, operational leadership, and customers to ensure proposals are accurate, complete, and aligned with customer requirements and submission deadlines.

Our ideal **Project Manager – Proposals** candidate will be a highly organized, motivated individual with excellent communication and interpersonal skills who is comfortable managing multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment. This position combines proposal coordination, customer relationship management, and administrative project support. The successful candidate will serve as a key point of contact between customers and internal teams, helping ensure proposals move efficiently from the estimating stage through final submission.

**What will you do in this position?**

**Proposal Development & Coordination**

* Coordinate the preparation, review, and submission of proposals for electrical construction and infrastructure projects within the Major Projects division.
* Work closely with the estimating team to gather project estimates, supporting documentation, and other information required to develop customer proposals.
* Utilize established company proposal templates to prepare professional, accurate, and complete proposal packages.
* Review estimates, proposal documents, and customer requirements to ensure all requested information, scope details, and deliverables are properly addressed.
* Coordinate revisions and updates to proposals based on feedback from customers, estimating teams, and internal leadership.
* Help ensure proposals are completed accurately and submitted within established customer deadlines.

**Customer Relations & Communication**

* Serve as a point of contact for customers regarding proposal status, submission timelines, and general project inquiries.
* Maintain regular communication with customers to provide updates, address questions, and coordinate changes to proposal requirements or deadlines.
* Build and maintain positive working relationships with customers through professional, responsive, and effective communication.
* Coordinate customer requests and feedback with internal estimating and operational teams to ensure expectations are understood and addressed.
* Assist leadership with customer follow-ups and ongoing communication related to active proposals and potential projects.

**Proposal Scheduling & Deadline Management**

* Track and manage multiple active proposals, bid deadlines, and customer submission requirements.
* Maintain organized records of proposal statuses, due dates, revisions, and outstanding action items.
* Coordinate with estimators and internal stakeholders to ensure required information is received and incorporated into proposals on schedule.
* Identify potential delays or challenges that could impact proposal deadlines and communicate concerns proactively.

**Reports to:** Creative Ops Lead  
**Direct Reports:** None  
**Position Type:** Contract-to-hire. 3 month contract with the intent to convert to a full-time role  
**Classification:** 1099 contract employee of BRAINS  
**Schedule:** Starting part time at 20-30 hours per week  
**Location:** Remote

**About the Role**  
The Project Manager runs day-to-day project operations, coordinating cross-functional teams and ensuring deliverables meet client expectations on time and within budget. This is an agency role: you'll manage several client projects at once in a fast-moving, client-service environment, so prior agency experience is required. The primary focus of this role will be a high-volume retainer client with a variety of task types and workstreams. The role starts as a 3-month contract, and we plan to convert it to a full-time position at BRAINS for the right person.  
  
***Due to client and team, candidates in the Pacific Time zone are strongly preferred for this position.***

**Key Responsibilities**

**Project Leadership & Delivery**

* Create and maintain project timelines and scopes of work.
* Define clear project plans, track milestones, and anticipate risks to ensure smooth delivery.
* Monitor progress and escalate risks/issues as needed.
* Lead status meetings and project check-ins.
* Maintain visibility across multiple workstreams to ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with agency quality standards.

**Team Operations & Collaboration**

* Manage resourcing across assigned projects, ensuring workloads are balanced.
* Facilitate communication between account, creative, and production teams.
* Partner closely with account leads, strategists, and creatives to align project delivery with strategic objectives.
* Identify and escalate blockers for assigned project teams, ensuring momentum and accountability throughout the lifecycle of a project.

**Budgeting & Reporting**

* Collaborate closely with account leads to align on budgets and schedules.
* Track and report on project performance metrics.

**Who You Are**

* **A Systems Thinker**  
  You’re fluent in designing workflows that balance structure with flexibility and know how to keep teams aligned and focused.
* **An Operational Strategist**  
  You understand how delivery, process, and planning intersect with business health, client satisfaction, and creative excellence.
* **A Skilled Communicator**  
  You bring clarity, empathy, and precision to how you communicate, whether with clients, internal teams, or team leadership.
* **A Confident Problem-Solver**  
  You stay calm under pressure and have a knack for untangling complexity, resolving issues, and keeping momentum.

**Experience**

* **Required:** 3–5 years of agency project management experience, ideally in a creative/advertising environment. In-house or brand-side project management experience alone won't be a fit for this role.
* Hands-on experience running agency client work: scopes of work, retainer and project budgets, client approvals, and creative review rounds across multiple accounts at once.
* Advanced knowledge of project management tools. BRAINS uses Asana for project management.
* Strong understanding of creative processes (digital, motion, print, production, etc.).
* Excellent multitasking, problem-solving, and interpersonal skills.

**Contract-to-Hire Details**

The Senior IT Program Manager provides direction to the project managers, business analysts, and vendor delivery teams assigned to each initiative, serves as the primary escalation point below executive leadership, and is accountable for delivering the program on schedule, within scope, and within budget.
  
  
At a high level, the resource will provide strategic leadership and program oversight, applying senior-level management capabilities, executive communication, financial management, and vendor and contract coordination to support the delivery of complex technology initiatives. The program will encompass cloud-based vendor software, commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) solutions, and custom development efforts delivered through Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid methodologies.  
  
  
  
Tasks
  
Strategic program planning**:** Develop and manage the program strategy, roadmap, integrated schedule, and governance framework collaboratively with leadership and in alignment with client objectives.
  
Multi-project coordination**:** Oversee multiple interconnected projects, managing the overall program plan, schedule cross-project dependencies, sequencing, and resource allocation.
  
Executive stakeholder management**:** Present program status, risks, and recommendations to executive sponsors and governance bodies.
  
Cross-functional team leadership**:** Direct and coordinate project managers and cross-functional business and technical teams, collaboratively and usually without direct authority.
  
Budget and resource management**:** Monitor program budget and spend, optimize the allocation of staff and resources across projects, forecast and communicate program funding needs over the life of the program.
  
Risk and issue resolution**:** Identify, assess, mitigate, and transparently escalate program-level risks, issues, and dependencies, using the processes established in the program governance model.
  
Vendor and partner management**:** Oversee vendor performance against contracted scope, schedule, and deliverables, and maintain accurate records of vendor commitments and performance.
  
Change management**:** Coordinate with organizational change management to prepare IT staff and business areas to adopt new systems and processes.
  
Performance measurement**:** Establish program measures and deliver regular, objective reporting on program health and progress.
  
Process improvement**:** Identify and implement program and project management best practices, consistent with client IT standards.

Provide knowledge transfer.
  
  
Desired Skills
  
Bachelor's degree in business, information technology, public administration, or a related field.
  
Ten or more years of project and program management experience, including at least five years leading multi-project programs in a matrixed environment, directing project managers and cross-functional business and technical teams without direct authority.
  
Active PMP or PgMP certification.
  
Two or more **years of experience** in corrections, public safety, or justice, either in government or with a vendor serving those agencies.
  
Experience leading a legacy system replacement or commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) implementation through go-live, including data conversion, cutover planning, and post-go-live stabilization.
  
Experience managing program financials, including budget tracking against actuals, spend forecasting across multiple fiscal years, variance analysis, and reporting to sponsors and finance.
  
Experience managing resource capacity across multiple concurrent projects, including allocating staff and contractors and forecasting future resource needs.
  
Experience building and maintaining an integrated program schedule, including cross-project dependencies, sequencing, and critical path management.
  
Experience owning program-level risk and issue management (RAID), including assessment, mitigation planning, and escalation through a formal governance structure.
  
Experience producing recurring program status and health reporting with defined metrics, and presenting status, risks, and recommendations for decision to executive sponsors and steering committees.

Experience leading data governance, analytics, or data platform initiatives.
  
Experience coordinating external program or project audits, including audit responses and corrective action plans.
  
Experience managing hybrid Agile and waterfall delivery within a single program.
  
Experience partnering with organizational change management to drive adoption of new systems and processes.
  
Experience developing business cases and financial models for technology investments.
  
MBA or other advanced degree.
