jobs.description:
**About Frontier Psychiatry**

Frontier Psychiatry is a physician-led, tech-enabled telehealth organization on a mission to

improve the mental well-being of people in rural communities nationwide.

We provide timely, scalable, evidence-based psychiatry and addiction care to individuals who

might otherwise face long wait times or significant travel barriers to receiving treatment.

Our work is guided by the Quintuple Aim:

* Excellent patient care
* Team well-being
* Lower total cost of care
* Improved population health
* Health equity

We believe everyone deserves access to high-quality mental health care, regardless of where

they live. Join us in making that possible.

**The Short Version**

The Referral & Scheduling Care Coordinator plays an essential role in connecting patients to

the care they need. This position manages incoming referrals, coordinates patient scheduling, supports provider schedule utilization, and maintains strong communication with patients and referring partners.

You will collaborate closely with colleagues across the organization to ensure patients experience a smooth, timely transition from referral to their first appointment while supporting the operational efficiency of our growing clinical team.

**Why This Role Exists**

Frontier Psychiatry was founded to improve access to mental health and addiction care in rural communities where patients often wait months—or travel hours—for services. Access starts long before the first appointment.

The Referral & Scheduling Care Coordinator plays a critical role in ensuring patients move efficiently from referral to care. This position directly impacts how quickly patients are scheduled, how well providers' schedules are utilized, and how effectively we serve referring partners.

We are hiring a Referral & Scheduling Care Coordinator to help deliver timely, organized, and patient-centered access to care as we continue to grow across multiple states. **Bilingual Intake Coordinator (English/Spanish)**  
Headstart Health | Fully Remote | Full-Time  
$55,000–$65,000 annually

Be the warm, welcoming first introduction to Headstart for families seeking autism care. You’ll help families feel heard, understand their next steps, and move through intake with personal, attentive support.

**Fluent spoken Spanish is required.** You’ll support families in both English and Spanish. We strongly prefer availability for a schedule of approximately **9 a.m.–6 p.m. Pacific Time or Mountain Time**.

* $55,000–$65,000 annual salary, based on relevant experience and qualifications.
* Fully remote, full-time position.
* Health-insurance reimbursement to help cover the cost of your coverage.
* Unlimited paid time off, coordinated with your manager to maintain team coverage.
* Close collaboration with the Lead Manager and operations team, with opportunities to develop your skills as Headstart grows.

**About Headstart Health**

Headstart Health helps Board Certified Behavior Analysts (BCBAs) build and run independent autism-care practices. We support intake, credentialing, billing, and recruiting so clinicians can focus on providing care to children and families.

**About the Role**

You’ll guide families from their first conversation with Headstart through gathering records and preparing for insurance verification. You’ll answer questions, coordinate with referring offices, and keep next steps moving while making each interaction feel personal.

Working with our Lead Manager and Insurance Operations team, you’ll help resolve delays and prepare thoughtful handoffs. Families should know who to contact, understand what’s needed, and trust you to follow through.

**What You’ll Do**

* Welcome families, conduct scheduled intake calls, and follow up by phone, text, and email in English and Spanish.
* Listen to families’ questions, explain the intake process clearly, and keep them informed about next steps.
* Collect and track clinical, insurance, demographic, and intake documents; coordinate with families, referring offices, and schools to obtain missing records.
* Review referrals and faxes, document outreach and call outcomes, and maintain accurate Salesforce records.
* Help families complete portal setup and prepare organized handoffs to Insurance Operations.
* Flag stalled cases, time-sensitive needs, and complex questions to the Lead Manager, and suggest practical improvements to the family experience.

**What You’ll Bring**

**Required**

* Fluent spoken Spanish and strong English communication skills, including the ability to conduct a family intake conversation in either language.
* At least one year of experience in patient intake, care coordination, healthcare operations, or a similar frontline support role.
* A friendly, personable phone presence, strong listening skills, and comfort with frequent calls and outreach.
* Strong organization, attention to detail, and dependable follow-through across multiple families at different stages of intake.
* Comfort using digital tools, learning new systems, and handling confidential patient information.
* The ability to work independently, ask thoughtful questions, and adapt as processes evolve.

**Preferred**

* Hands-on Salesforce experience is a significant plus, especially managing leads, documenting outreach, and using task queues or reports. Experience with another CRM is also helpful.
* Experience in ABA, behavioral health, or pediatric healthcare.
* Familiarity with insurance eligibility, benefits verification, or payer documentation requirements.
* Experience with Aircall or similar phone systems, virtual fax tools, and Google Workspace.

**What Success Looks Like**

Families experience you as friendly, welcoming, and dependable. You remember the details, follow up when promised, and keep them informed when something is delayed. Your records are current and your handoffs give teammates the context they need to continue that care.

**How to Apply**

Submit your résumé. You’re welcome to include a brief note about your experience and interest in Headstart, but it isn’t required.

Part of the interview process will be conducted in Spanish with a fluent Spanish-speaking member of our team to assess how clearly and warmly you communicate with families.

Pay: $55,000.00 - $65,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Language:

* Spanish (Required)

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Customer Care Specialist II (US)
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

**Verathon** is a global medical device company committed to being a trusted partner to our customers and advancing patient care through innovative Airway Management and Urology solutions. For more than 40 years, we have worked alongside healthcare professionals to understand their needs and deliver high-quality technologies that provide lasting clinical and economic value.

Our portfolio includes leading GlideScope**®** video laryngoscopy and BFlex™ bronchoscopy solutions, BladderScan**®** bladder volume measurement, and a growing range of single-use Urology solutions. Behind our innovations is a diverse, global team united by a commitment to our customers, collaboration, and improving patient care.

Verathon, a business unit of Roper Technologies, is headquartered in Bothell, Washington, with international subsidiaries in Canada, Europe, and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit www.verathon.com.

Overview:

Be Part of Our Story

Bring your talents to a rapidly growing, industry-leading global medical device company.

We operate with a singular focus of empowering healthcare professionals to better serve their patients. Our unique products and services help clinicians see the hidden realities of the human body, giving them insights they need to optimize patient care.

For us, it starts with people: our team, our customers, and the patients they serve. Our innovation is based on finding new ways to offer simplicity where complexity exists. We also look for opportunities to increase the velocity of patient care, ultimately providing solutions that improve and extend patients’ lives.

Your Business — Customer Care

As a **Customer Care Specialist**, you’ll deliver total customer care across orders, product and training inquiries, and moderate‑level technical support. You’ll serve as a trusted partner to clinicians and administrators by resolving issues with urgency and empathy, and by guiding users through device and software workflows.

Responsibilities:

How You'll Add Value

* **Customer Support & Case Handling** — Respond to inbound calls and emails for products, training requests, general information, and moderate technical issues; create and manage cases to resolution.
* **Order Management** — Accurately enter and process customer orders; provide proactive updates and follow‑ups for order status and repair approvals.
* **Returns & Credits** — Issue return authorizations (RAs) for repairs and credits in alignment with company policies.
* **Technical Troubleshooting** — Guide customers through phone and email troubleshooting of medical devices and software, including Windows applications, web‑based tools, drivers, permissions, wireless connectivity, server issues, and unit‑specific error codes.
* **Suggestive Solutions** — Identify opportunities to promote additional value‑add products, services, or training that solve customer problems.

Qualifications:

Who We're Looking For

**Key Attributes:**

* **Customer‑Obsessed:** You build rapport quickly, listen deeply, and communicate clearly under pressure.
* **Tech‑Savvy Problem Solver:** You can navigate Windows OS, web apps, wireless technology, and basic networking concepts and can translate them for non‑technical users.
* **Process‑Driven & Precise:** You keep your queue organized, document thoroughly, and follow through reliably.
* **Continuous Learner:** You’re eager to build clinical, regulatory (FDA/HIPAA), and product knowledge in a dynamic environment.
* **Team First:** You collaborate across Customer Care, Technical Support, Sales, Service, and Finance to resolve issues end‑to‑end and provide backup support for the Customer Care Sales Support position.

**The Basic Requirements:**

* Associate degree or equivalent experience.
* Typically 1–2 years of direct customer service experience.
* Experience with high-volume inbound/outbound calls and email support.
* Proficiency with Windows OS, web‑based software, and wireless technology.
* Aptitude and desire to troubleshoot permissions, drivers, error codes, server connectivity, and related software issues.
* Willingness and capability to accurately maintain logs, records, and files, both manually and electronically.

**Synapse Health | Who We Are**

Synapse exists to make DME simpler and more connected for everyone involved, from patients and providers to health plans and suppliers. Through our technology platform, we make sure patients receive the right product, at the right time, in the right amount. We've reached real scale, but there's still a lot left to build, which means the work here has visible impact, not incremental polish.

In this role, you're the direct connection between patients, providers, and health plans, and the impact is tangible and immediate. Your input shapes how things run day to day, and from first touch to delivery, you'll help earn the trust of every patient we serve.

Since 2016, with decades of industry and leadership experience, we've delivered tech-based solutions that help our partners to modernize operations, improve coordination, and reduce administrative burdens. By taking on operational and financial complexity, we're redefining how DME works for providers, prescribers, and patients. We are proud to offer ***work that matters, on a mission that*** ***matter******s*****.**

**What We Need****:**

The ***Workforce Management Real-Time Analyst*** owns intraday performance across our domestic and global contact center operations. You will monitor queues, staffing, and adherence throughout the day, make timely adjustments to meet service levels, and serve as the primary point of contact for real-time decisions.

Working closely with our WFM Analysts, operations leaders, and global partners, you will help protect the patient and provider experience while allowing frontline leaders to focus on coaching and developing their teams.

**What You Will Do****:**

*Real-time monitoring and queue management*

*Attendance and schedule exceptions*

* Own the domestic attendance line: receive and log callouts, late arrivals, and early departures in the WFM system, and notify the agent's leader the same day.
* Process same-day schedule exceptions, including break and lunch moves, shift changes, and time-off requests, within approved guidelines.
* Keep schedules and attendance records accurate, so leaders have reliable data for attendance conversations.

*Adherence and agent engagement*

* Track schedule adherence and agent states (after-call work, hold, aux codes) throughout the day, flagging unusual patterns.
* Engage agents directly in real time when out of adherence and escalate repeat patterns to their leader.

*Reporting and continuous improvement*

* Publish intraday updates, daily and weekly productivity reports, and an end-of-day variance summary, and serve as the first point of contact for intraday questions from leaders and partner sites.
* Document intraday trends and root causes to inform forecasting, scheduling, and the intraday playbook.

*Note: These responsibilities reflect the general nature and scope of the role but are not exhaustive. Responsibilities may evolve to meet changing business needs.*

**What You Have****:**

At Synapse Health, we've intentionally built a culture rooted in kindness, collaboration, and creativity, qualities we consider essential for every team member. Additional requirements include:

* 1–2+ years of WFM real-time analyst experience, or strong familiarity with contact center metrics such as service level, adherence, occupancy, and handle times.

* Clear, direct, and respectful communication, including redirecting agents on adherence in real time.
* Availability to work between 8:00 a.m. and 8:00 p.m. ET (Monday – Saturday coverage).
* Knowledge of durable medical equipment (DME) business strongly preferred.

**What Sets You Apart****:**

* Analytical Problem Solver: Spots patterns in intraday data, troubleshoots issues quickly, and turns findings into practical actions.
* Calm Ownership: Makes sound decisions under pressure and follows every issue through to resolution.
* Detail-Oriented and Consistent: Keeps records accurate and applies guidelines the same way for every team.
* Adaptable and Tech-Savvy: Comfortable with change, quick to adopt new tools, and motivated by continuous improvement.
* Influence Without Authority: Earns trust with agents, leaders, and partner sites so real-time requests get acted on.

**Compensation:**

The pay range for this position is $20.38 – $25.50 per hour. This range reflects the anticipated compensation at the time of posting. Final compensation will be based on factors such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, internal equity, and prevailing market conditions. Compensation discussions are encouraged throughout the hiring process.

**PROGRAM OVERVIEW**

The Jewish Leadership Accelerator (JLA) is a highly selective nine-month fellowship that brings the most ambitious young Jewish leaders in their 20s into one room. It was founded by philanthropist Laura Lauder through The Jewish Leadership Fund and Jewish Federation Bay Area and will launch in San Francisco in January 2027 with an inaugural cohort of 20 fellows before expanding nationally.

Over nine months, fellows sit down to private dinners with founders, investors and public leaders currently shaping the city, and moderate those dinners themselves. They take part in a day-long weekend retreat, set their own mentorship goals with introductions through JLA's network, and close the fellowship with JLAction, where they share their leadership vision with mentors and community leaders. Fellows receive a $2,000 stipend on completion and join a lifelong alumni network.

**ROLE SUMMARY**

The Program Manager is the engine behind JLA's first few cohorts. Reporting to the Program Director, they will think strategically about how the program should run, then get into the details to make it happen: planning the retreat, curating and preparing speakers, producing each weeknight dinner, and working hands-on with fellows from application onward. This is a new role at a new program. The Program Manager will build systems in real time, and the processes they document will become the playbook for JLA's expansion. The ideal candidate is organized, high-energy, and self-directed; equally at ease with a 25-year-old fellow and a foundation board chair; and motivated by building something new rather than inheriting an established structure. The role is base in Bay Area working primarily remotely with occasional travel, local meetings and events.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

**Strategic Planning and Program Management**

* **Planning:** Partner with the Program Director on the nine-month plan: the program calendar, cohort timeline and session themes. Run a debrief after each dinner and gather fellow feedback to improve the next one.
* **Project management:** Own timelines, task lists and deadlines across every workstream. Prepare updates for Laura Lauder, the JLA Board, and advisory committees.
* **Budget and vendors:** Manage the program budget day to day, including stipends, vendor contracts and event costs.
* **Data and KPIs:** Keep fellow, speaker and partner records current, and report on fellow engagement, attendance, retention and alumni activity.

**Retreat, Dinners and Speakers**

* **Retreat:** Plan and run the day-long weekend retreat early in the fellowship, including venue selection, curriculum, and day-of logistics.
* **Speaker curation:** Work with the Program Director and founder to identify, invite and confirm the speakers for each dinner, with two guests per evening from business, tech, government and communal life. Support speaker outreach, scheduling, and keep speaker bios and materials current.
* **Speaker and dinner prep:** Prepare a brief for every speaker on the format, the cohort and the topic, and build a run-of-show for each evening.
* **Dinner logistics:** Coordinate venue selection, catering, guest lists, and day-of coordination.

**Hands-On Work with Fellows**

* **Fellow preparation:** Coach the teams of two to three fellows who moderate each dinner, introducing guests, leading the opening Q&A and running table discussions, so they walk in ready.
* **Day-to-day support:** Be the first point of contact for every fellow and offer support when needed.
* **Community:** Support JLA-funded, fellow-curated social gatherings and administer microgrant requests.

**Selection, Alumni and Expansion**

* **Selection:** Run the day-to-day of admissions: applications, rolling review, nominations and references, Selection Committee interviews, and timely communication with every applicant.
* **Alumni engagement:** Run local alumni events and support the annual cross-city gathering so the network stays active as each cohort joins.
* **Expansion:** Document processes, templates and lessons learned from the first cohort as input to the playbook for New York City and future cities.

Requirements:

**QUALIFICATIONS, KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES**

**Required**

* Hands-on experience in program or project management: comfortable planning, prioritizing and tracking many workstreams, timelines, and vendors at once, with strategic thinking about what the next cohort needs.
* Ability to move fast and work well under pressure, achieving event and program deadlines, and staying calm and organized when plans change.
* Self-sufficient, with strong judgment: Confident in making decisions and solving problems without much guidance and knowing when to bring something to the Program Director.
* Comfort being public facing: represent JLA at dinners, the retreat and JLAction, welcome speakers and guests, and speak with confidence in front of fellows, senior leaders and donors.
* Excellent written, verbal and interpersonal communication, with the range to engage fellows in their 20s and founders, investors, donors and senior leaders with equal ease.
* An entrepreneurial spirit: comfort building a pilot from launch toward a multi-city model.
* Passion for building Jewish life in America among young Jewish leaders.
* Highly polished, passionate, and professional.
* Availability to work evenings and weekends as needed
* Ability to travel on occasion.

**Preferred**

* Past and current involvement in the Jewish community.
* Working knowledge of the Jewish communal and philanthropic landscape and of young adult engagement (the campus-to-young-professional pipeline).
* Experience with a fellowship, cohort-based or selective-admissions program.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor's degree
* 3+ years of experience in project management, ideally relating to community engagement, leadership development, or cohort-based programs.

Salary commensurate with experience. Excellent benefits

**Enterprise Customer Success Manager**

**Location:** Remote | **Department:** Customer Success | **Reports to:** Director of Customer Success

More than 2,750 institutions and organizations use Gravyty to power over 25.5 million interactions a year and build lifelong relationships with students, alumni, and donors. We’re looking for a commercially minded Enterprise Customer Success Manager to protect and grow some of our most important partnerships. You’ll be a trusted advisor to your customers and own the results: renewals, expansion, and long-term retention.

**Purpose**

Retain and grow a portfolio of enterprise customers by preventing churn, driving renewals, and expanding accounts. Build strong relationships and deliver real outcomes along the way.

**Mission & Goals**

* Act as a trusted strategic advisor to customer leaders and executive stakeholders

* Maximize customer satisfaction and product adoption

* Prevent churn and drive renewal and expansion across your enterprise portfolio

**Responsibilities**

* Own a portfolio of high-value enterprise accounts and be accountable for churn, retention, and expansion targets

* Lead renewal and expansion conversations, including cross-selling new solutions, especially our latest product launch

* Identify risks early and act on them, and spot expansion opportunities and customer champions

* Deliver QBRs, success plans, and strategic executive check-ins

* Work with Sales, Product, Support, and Marketing to solve customer issues and grow accounts

**Main Tasks**

* Track progress against your churn, retention, and expansion targets, and build action plans to close any gaps

* Monitor health scores and engagement metrics to catch risk and opportunity early

* Run renewal, expansion, and cross-sell opportunities from identification through close

* Guide customers through adoption milestones and business reviews

* Document success plans and account activity in our CRM and CS platforms

* Use AI tools to streamline account prep, reporting, and day-to-day workflows

**Required Qualifications**

* A proven commercial track record in preventing churn, securing renewals, and growing accounts, with results you can point to

* 5+ years of B2B SaaS Enterprise Customer Success experience

* Experience in EdTech, higher education, or nonprofit

* Experience managing enterprise-level accounts and engaging executive stakeholders

* Demonstrated success cross-selling or upselling into existing accounts

* Strong communication and negotiation skills

* Comfort using AI tools, such as Claude Enterprise, to optimize your work and workflows

* Experience with digital engagement platforms such as CRM, email marketing tools, and CS software like Gainsight

* Strategic thinking and planning, plus the ability to juggle multiple priorities without losing customer focus

* Experience working with dashboards and reporting

**How You Work**

You take ownership and follow through. You hold yourself accountable for results, and when things get tough you stay resilient and positive. You’re organized, you take initiative, and you have a bias toward action, efficiency, and continuous improvement. You build relationships easily, with an approachable style that puts customers and teammates at ease. You’re self-aware, you give and receive feedback openly, and you’re a true team player and help make the people around you better.

**About Gravyty**

At Gravyty, we’re redefining how higher education, K-12, and nonprofits engage students, alumni, and donors. Our AI-powered platform breaks down data and technology silos. It brings student support, enrollment, retention, and lifelong alumni and donor engagement together in one intelligent platform. Trusted by more than 2,750 institutions and organizations, Gravyty drives better outcomes, greater efficiency, and stronger connections.

Our global team of passionate professionals share a commitment to innovation, excellence, and making a real impact. If you want to be part of a dynamic, purpose-driven company, Gravyty is the place for you.

We offer competitive benefits, employer-matched retirement plans, flexible time off, and a supportive environment where your contributions make a difference.

We’re committed to an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. If you need an accommodation at any stage of hiring, please let us know and we’ll work with you to meet your needs.

Pink Callers is a ServiceTitan Certified Call Center built for HVAC, plumbing, roofing, and electrical contractors. As our After Hours Call Center Manager, you'll help contractors stay responsive when their customers need them most.

We combine human skill with AI-driven efficiency, which means you won't be stuck doing mindless busywork all night. You'll be part of a team that values being proactive, transparent, problem-solving, leadership, and real teamwork.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

Your shift starts when many teams are winding down. You'll be the steady hand after hours, managing incoming calls and customer interactions when urgency is high and patience is low.

You'll talk with homeowners who need help now. You'll guide the conversation, create clarity, and turn that moment into a booked opportunity for our clients. When you do it well, families get help faster and contractors wake up to real business on the board.

This role matters because after-hours service is where trust is won or lost. If you like being the person who keeps things calm, sharp, and handled, you'll feel that here.

* You'll get a text for a quick 1-way video question. (5 min)
* We'll send you a link to get scheduled for an in-person interview.
* You can easily be in for an interview within a couple days from right now.

### **What You'll Earn**

You'll work a full 40-hour schedule and earn $22-$25 per hour, based on your experience. There's also a $500 bonus opportunity after your New Hire Introductory Period. If you're looking for a role where strong after-hours performance and ServiceTitan expertise can turn into real professional development, that's part of the path here too.

### **Why Work With Us**

This is for people who like ownership, not hand-holding. If you're proactive, transparent, and naturally step in to solve problems, you'll fit right in.

This is not for someone who wants a slow shift, vague expectations, or a team that lets things slide. After-hours work needs sharp communication, consistency, and follow-through.

**About Your Role:**

We are seeking an experienced and results-oriented Customer Success Manager (CSM) to own, manage, and strategically grow a dedicated portfolio of our most valued customers. As a CSM, you will be the primary, trusted advisor responsible for driving product adoption, ensuring clients achieve measurable Return on Investment (ROI), and securing high-value renewals and expansions. This is a high-impact, client-facing role requiring a proactive approach, deep strategic thinking, and a proven ability to manage complex relationships within a fast-paced Software as a Service (SaaS) environment. You will play a critical role in strengthening our market presence by transforming satisfied customers into strong advocates and partners. This is a remote position.

**Who You Are**:

* A Proven Professional: You have a minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience as a Customer Success Manager or in a similar strategic account management role within a B2B SaaS company.
* Strategic Relationship Builder: You are a skilled executive communicator who can develop deep, trust-based relationships with key stakeholders, including C-level executives and decision-makers.
* Value and ROI Focused: You are adept at identifying a customer's core business challenges and mapping our platform's capabilities directly to their measurable business outcomes.
* Growth Driver: You have a track record of driving higher net retention by identifying, scoping, and closing upsell and cross-sell opportunities within your assigned accounts.
* Data-Driven: You use customer usage data, health scores, and business metrics to inform your strategy, proactively address risks, and confidently present your findings in formal Executive Business Reviews (EBRs).
  

**Your Typical Day:**

**What is Reach Financial?**

Reach Financial is a FinTech platform helping people outsmart debt for good.

We are building innovative products and best-in-class support that enable our customers to take control of their debt and de-mystify their personal finances. Our products and tools empower our customers to turn their financial goals into a reality.

Reach Financial launched in 2015 and has helped our customers pay off over $1 billion in debt. We offer debt consolidation loans and personal loans; together, these markets represent a $1.5T opportunity. In time, we will expand beyond these products to offer solutions for a variety of our customers' personal finance challenges.

We are a fast-growing and fast-paced FinTech startup with the stability of an established firm. You will have a front-row seat at a rapidly growing company innovating the FinTech industry.

**About the Role**

The Customer Experience Manager leads frontline operations, ensuring the effective execution of departmental strategies, achievement of performance goals, and alignment with organizational priorities.

This role is responsible for leading, coaching, and developing Team Leads, overseeing employee performance management, maintaining quality and compliance standards, and optimizing workforce management. The Customer Experience Manager reports directly to the Director of Customer Experience.

**What You Will Do**

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead, coach, and develop Team Leads and Operations Specialists through biweekly 1:1s.
* Drive the weekly Team Lead meeting on performance trends, process fixes, and training gaps.

* Oversee formal corrective action and performance improvement plans in partnership with People & Culture, including appropriate documentation and escalation.
* Complete Team Lead reviews and support under-performing agent coaching.

**Operations & Workforce Management**

* Own daily operational execution, workload prioritization, scheduling, coverage, PTO, and timecard approvals. Delegate routine monitoring and follow-through to Team Leads.
* Assess demand, capacity, adherence, and coverage risks. Recommend staffing changes to the Director, who retains ownership of staffing forecasts and headcount decisions.
* Resolve second-level customer and operational escalations, document outcomes, and coordinate root-cause remediation with relevant partners.
* Maintain accurate procedures and knowledge resources. Obtain required approvals before publishing policy changes and coordinate training and implementation.

**Quality & Compliance**

* Calibrate QA scoring across the three teams, spot-check calls and emails for required disclosures, UDAAP language, and script adherence per bank partner expectations.
* Coordinate with Compliance, QA, and the Director to investigate exceptions, implement corrective actions, and verify remediation. Escalate significant customer, compliance, or operational risks promptly.

**Reporting & Performance**

* Own departmental KPI performance, including volume, abandon rate, QA, CSAT, AHT, ACW, Speed to Answer and Adherence.
* Validate and consolidate Team Lead reporting, maintain scorecards, and provide the Director with actionable findings, risks, and recommendations. Partner with relevant teams to resolve operational dependencies.
* Own performance improvement for quality, customer treatment, productivity, and employee development measures.
* Validate bonus calculations and supporting data, resolve discrepancies, and submit accurate results to designated recipients within established deadlines.

**What You Should Have**

* At least three years of customer service experience, including two years in a supervisory role, with demonstrated ownership of team performance and operational execution.
* Demonstrated ability to develop leaders, evaluate coaching effectiveness, administer corrective action with People & Culture, and maintain employee engagement.
* Experience in consumer loan servicing, working knowledge of UDAAP, regulatory complaint handling, and bank partner compliance expectations.
* Experience with workforce management and contact center tools (e.g., Amazon Connect, Salesforce, Rippling).
* Strong analytical, communication, and organizational skills, including the ability to identify root causes, manage competing priorities, and drive actions to completion.

**What is it like working at Reach Financial?**

Our culture is built around advancing our teams, and we are dedicated to the success and growth of every team member. We believe in retaining a high-performing workforce and we prioritize diversity, intellectual curiosity, and continued learning. Our generous benefits packages reflect that.

We’ve been hard at work perfecting our product for years, and now we’re growing faster than ever before. Our strong foundation and company culture is readily equipped for this growth, and we believe that with the right people, our products will continue to help customers make real changes in their financial lives.

**What benefits will you receive?**

* Healthcare, Life Insurance, 401k Match
* Paid Time Off, Paid 12-week Parental Leave
* Disability (short-term, long-term), Employee Assistance Program
* Spending Accounts (Transit/Parking, Medical, Dependent Care)
* Insurance Discounts (home, auto, pet)

75,000 - 95,000 USD per year(Remote (United States))

jobs.description:
**About Haven Housing Solutions**

Haven Housing Solutions (HHS) is a turnkey furnished housing company operating in all 50 states. When a family is displaced by a fire, flood, or storm, insurance carriers and their partners call us to get that family into a fully furnished, move in ready home, fast. We also house corporate professionals on assignment and support government agencies. We are lean, we move quickly, we are relationship driven, and we are growing.

**Why This Role**

* **Uncapped commission.** Every placement you close pays you. No cap, no ceiling.
* **Six figure earning potential.** Base salary plus commission, with top performers clearing six figures.
* **Fully remote, flexible hours.** Work from home on a flexible schedule.
* **A real path up.** We promote from within. Prove it here and grow into a Team Lead, and leadership roles as HHS scales.
* **A modern sales stack.** Salesforce, M365, AI tools, and automation built to keep you selling instead of doing busy work.
* **Work that matters.** Every deal you close puts a displaced family into a home during one of the hardest weeks of their lives.

**What You Will Do**

* Prospect and cold call insurance adjusters, claims teams, third party administrators, and public adjusters to open new accounts and grow existing ones.
* Run outbound sequences in Salesforce and build relationships that turn into repeat business.
* Work incoming housing requests fast: review options, negotiate with landlords and property managers, and build tiered quotes that win.
* Present options quickly, handle objections, and close the placement.
* Coordinate tours, collect lease details, and hand off cleanly to our Customer Care team for move in.
* Keep every account, contact, and deal accurate and current in Salesforce.
* Use AI every day to research accounts, prep for calls, draft outreach, and move faster.
* Hit and beat your monthly placement and revenue targets.

**What You Must Bring**

* 2+ years of cold calling and outbound sales experience with a track record of hitting or beating quota.
* Hands on Salesforce experience: managing a pipeline, logging activity, and working from reports.
* Daily, practical use of AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot, or Grok, and the drive to keep getting better with them.
* Commission motivation: you want your income tied to your results.
* Clear, confident, professional written and verbal English; you will speak daily with insurance professionals daily.
* Self-starter who manages a full pipeline without being chased.
* Authorized to work in the US, with a quiet home office and reliable high-speed internet.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in insurance housing, ALE, corporate housing, relocation, property management, real estate, or insurance claims.
* Experience with Dialpad or a similar VoIP dialer, and Microsoft 365.
* Experience with Salesforce Cadences or another sales engagement tool.

**No housing experience? No problem.** We will teach you the industry. You bring the sales drive.

**Is This You?**

**You will thrive here if**:

* Money motivates you and you want to be paid for performance.
* You would rather make one more call than leave a deal on the table.
* You track your own numbers and push to beat them.
* You want a seat that grows as the company grows.

**This is not the role for you if** you want the same paycheck regardless of results, you avoid the phone, or you need someone telling you what to do next.

**Compensation and Benefits**

**Pay range**: $80,000 to $130,000+ per year (base salary plus uncapped commission)

* Base salary plus uncapped commission on every placement you close.
* Performance bonuses on top of commission for high volume months.
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
* 401(k) retirement plan.
* Paid time off and company holidays.
* Fully remote with flexible working hours.
* Ongoing training in Salesforce, AI tools, and the insurance housing market.
* A clear advancement path for top performers.

Full compensation details are shared during the interview process.

**How to Apply**

Submit your resume with a short note answering these two questions:

* What was your best month in outbound sales, and what drove it?
* How do you use AI in your sales workflow today?

**Applications without answers to both questions will not be considered.**

Haven Housing Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome applicants of every background and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

The Value-Based Care Account Manager is an externally facing role in CVAUSA's Value-Based Care division that manages partnerships under total cost of care, sub-capitation cardiology, bundled payment, and pay-for-performance (P4P) arrangements. This role builds strong partner relationships, drives strategic alignment, participates in Joint Operating Committees, and ensures every contractual obligation and performance metric is met so both CVAUSA and its partners realize the value of the agreement.

* **Location:** Remote; preference for Eastern time zone; 25% travel
* **Direct reports:** None; works closely with the Value-based care team, Clinical Operations, Medical Economics, Data & Analytics, and Finance

**About CVAUSA**
----------------

At**Cardiovascular Associates of America (CVAUSA)****,** we believe the total cost of cardiovascular care is too high. The best way to find and remove avoidable cost is to equip cardiovascular physicians with new care models and new financial incentives through risk-based contracts.  
  
CVAUSA's value-based care division supports partner practices in transforming care models to improve quality, achieve the triple aim, and implement risk-based contracting. We are passionate about expanding access to evidence-based chronic disease care and building durable payment models that reward clinicians for delivering the right care, in the right place, at the right time.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Partner and payer relationship management**

* Serve as the liaison between the payer/health plan or health system, the CVAUSA value-based care team, and the practice in value-based care arrangements.
* Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with key partner stakeholders.
* Understand partner needs and priorities and identify opportunities for innovation and collaboration.
* Work with payers to identify, communicate, and resolve data discrepancies.
* Identify and surface to key team stakeholders’ additional business opportunities in partner relationships.

**Operational oversight**

* Ownership of Joint Operating Committee (JOC) meetings to align goals, performance, and issue resolution; collaborate for JOC materials with Medical Economics, Data & Analytics, Operations, and Leadership.
* Monitor contract performance and identify risks and improvement opportunities; partner with value-based care team on metric outlier management.
* Track quality, utilization, and total-cost-of-care results against each contract's targets, including shared savings and downside-risk terms.
* Track and manage quality performance throughout the contract year to validate payer reconciliation data.

**Strategic alignment**

* Understand the financial, clinical, and operational drivers of risk-bearing cardiology agreements.
* Work with analytics, medical economics, clinical operations, and finance teams to track outcomes, support decisions, and drive partner satisfaction.
* Proactively pursue opportunities to optimize performance under existing agreements.
* Understand partner objectives that may shape future contract renewals.

**Reporting and communication**

* Prepare and present performance updates, recommendations, and action plans to internal leadership and external partners.
* Ensure timely, transparent communication of risks, challenges, and achievements.
* Engage a broad spectrum of healthcare stakeholders, communicating at both the strategic and the tactical level.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in business administration, healthcare management, or a related field.
* 3+ years of experience in healthcare account management, provider relations, or a related field, with experience in value-based care.
* Value-based care experience with Medicare Advantage plans.
* Proven ability to manage complex partnerships and drive outcomes in risk-bearing arrangements (total cost of care, sub-capitation, bundled payments).
* Excellent interpersonal, negotiation, and communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to influence and build consensus among diverse stakeholders.
* Strong organizational and project management skills; able to manage multiple priorities at once.
* Ability to operate effectively within health plan environments and adapt to the different structures, requirements, and terms of each plan and contract.
* Familiarity with specialty value-based care clinical operations and financial modeling.
* Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and PowerPoint; comfortable working from BI dashboards.

**Preferred**

* Experience in cardiology or another specialty-focused value-based care model.
* Experience with athenahealth or other ambulatory EHRs and with care management or remote patient monitoring platforms.
* Prior work at an MSO, ACO, risk-bearing provider group, or health plan.
* Project management certification (PMP, Lean/Six Sigma) or equivalent experience running cross-functional implementations.

**Core Competencies**
---------------------

* Relationship management: Earns trust with health plan, payer, and contract counterparts — and with practice partners — while staying calm and constructive in escalations
* Analytical fluency: Reads claims and quality data accurately, spots trends early, and turns numbers into a short list of actions
* Clinical and financial literacy: Understands cardiovascular care pathways well enough to connect clinical workflow changes to cost and quality outcomes
* Execution: Runs multiple contracts and workstreams at once, keeps commitments, and closes the loop on every action item

**Company Description**

XP Power is a major supplier of critical power conversion technology to the medical, technology, industrial, and defence markets. We are a fast-growing company listed on the London Stock Exchange. We are looking for self-motivated professionals who thrive in dynamic environments. We are proud of and committed to our culture that values Customer Focus, Flexibility, Knowledge, Speed, and Integrity. XP Power is looking for an Operations Program Manager to lead the manufacturing elements of New Product Introduction (NPI) programs at our Silicon Valley site,. The role will also manage the deployment of key manufacturing process improvement projects as needed.

Our Silicon Valley team designs and builds custom power supply solutions for top companies in the industry including medical, semiconductor processing equipment and general industrial markets.

Programs here are designed/built under ISO9001 guidelines and have many moving parts during the Prototype/Pilot phases with the additional requirement of transferring the volume production from San Jose to Vietnam. Products can be classified as having medium-to-high technical complexity, short timelines, and high customer expectations.

Pinterest is looking for a standout Design Program Manager to own and execute design initiatives that drive product impact at Pinterest. Design Program Managers own and execute design programs that drive team impact and product initiatives forward at Pinterest. They develop programming focused on holistic product vision for the design team experience. They partner with design leadership to focus on delivery operations. They are experts at balancing strategic planning alongside execution, and know how to leverage stakeholders and partners to move programs forward. They are strong creative thinkers, who can break down complex problems and provide solutions to support their programs and the teams.

  

**What you'll do:**

* Partner with Design leadership and primary stakeholders to create a strategic project plan for complex, high profile project(s) based on a business need.
* Partner with Design leads to define primary stakeholders, determine scope, and gain leadership and xfn support for design programs based on the predefined project goals.
* Execute design programs ensuring the program team meets deadlines, tracking against design milestones and following up on action items through owning all program documentation and operations including communication plans, forums, and meeting cadences as required.
* Work cross functionally with teams internal and external to Design to turn ambiguous opportunities into actionable outcomes.
* Manage risk by proactively raising issues around programs before they become a roadblock, and work quickly to resolve any issues that may arise.
* Create transparency by acting as the point of contact for programs, providing regular updates and decisions to stakeholders and ensuring updates are visible within the company.
* Report on the success of programs and completing project closeout steps, post-mortems, and/or leading any followup iterative work.
* Expertise in defining, evolving, and applying systems, frameworks, and standards, including using AI-powered tools and workflows to help scale your approach and facilitates productive cross-functional collaboration

  

**What we're looking for:**

* Minimum 5 years product design program management experience or equivalent.
* SCRUM, Agile, or PMP certifications.
* Demonstrated proficiency in design program management across multiple product surfaces.
* Has a learner and builder mindset: Able to quickly onboard to emerging AI tools and implement them appropriately in the full product development process with a focus on decision quality, craft and efficiency. Mentors and educates team members.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, as well as exceptional organizational and time management skills.
* Proficient in JIRA, other project management software a plus

**About the job**
-----------------

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. Google is looking for a dynamic professional to lead all aspects of supply chain readiness in New Product Introduction (NPI) products for our global data centers.

As a Supply Chain Program Manager, you work with cross-functional teams starting with product inception to volume ramp to bring innovative products into global data centers efficiently and dynamically. You demonstrate domain expertise in material readiness, clear to build, supplier and contract manufacturer management, procurement, manufacturing, supply resiliency and are well versed in other aspects of operations and engineering that impact supply chain strategies and execution.

In this role, you are responsible for developing and executing materials plans, enabling prototype builds and driving production ramp plans for products deployed in our data centers. Product types include networking, infrastructure, and server and storage. You work closely with engineering, supply chain operations, supply and demand planning, contract manufacturing and supplier partners to launch new products and to implement processes and systems that directly scale new product deployments.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

**Role summary**

We have an exciting opportunity for an ERP Implementation Specialist to bring Talon’s newly acquired West Coast manufacturers onto our standard JobBOSS² ERP. You will work alongside Talon’s current ERP Implementation Specialist and the IT Director, taking each shop from spreadsheets, QuickBooks or a legacy ERP to a standardized JobBOSS² environment, and making sure the team actually uses it. This is a hands-on, travel-heavy role: expect to spend 40–60% of your time on-site at shops located on the West Coast, mapping processes on the floor, converting data, training users and supporting go-lives in person.

The role is remote, and you must live on the West Coast (Arizona, California, Nevada, Oregon or Washington) within 30 minutes of a major commercial airport.

**About Talon Precision**

Talon Precision is a group of precision manufacturing shops serving the aerospace and defense, semiconductor, space and medical device end markets. Our customers help keep the world safe, connected, healthy and prosperous. Our mission is to restore manufacturing excellence here at home. Each Talon business operates with its own president and team, supported by a common Talon IT platform, including JobBOSS² as our standard ERP, so our shops can focus on making great parts.

This role is a key part of how newly acquired West Coast businesses join that platform.

**Key responsibilities**

* Carry out full-cycle JobBOSS² implementations: discovery, process mapping, configuration, data migration, testing, training, cutover and post-go-live support.
* Execute conversions from other ERPs (Epicor, Infor and others), including data mapping, cleanup, validation and parallel runs, with minimal disruption to production and shipping.
* Apply and improve Talon’s standard JobBOSS² configuration across quoting, estimating, job costing, scheduling, purchasing, inventory, shipping, quality and accounting integration.
* Work with operations, finance, quality and shipping teams to redesign processes around the standard, not around old workarounds.
* Help assess the ERP and business processes of acquisition targets and estimate integration effort, risk and timeline.
* Maintain project plans and cutover checklists, and report status and risks to the IT Director.
* Train site users and develop super-users who support their teams after go-live.
* Coordinate with outside resources (ECi professional services, conversion consultants) and Talon’s managed service provider to keep work on scope and schedule.
* Ensure ERP data supports consolidated financial and operational reporting across Talon businesses.
* Configure access and handling of ITAR-controlled and CUI data in line with Talon’s CMMC Level 2 program.
* Maintain implementation playbooks, templates and documentation so each new site goes faster than the last.

**Required qualifications**

* 3+ years of ERP implementation or support experience in a manufacturing environment, including hands-on work on at least one full-cycle implementation or conversion.
* Hands-on experience with at least one of: JobBOSS² (ECi), Epicor (Kinetic / E10 / E2 Shop System) or Infor (SyteLine / CloudSuite Industrial, VISUAL).
* Working knowledge of job-shop or make-to-order processes: quoting, estimating, routings, job costing, scheduling, purchasing, inventory, shipping and invoicing.
* Proven data migration skills: extracting, mapping, cleaning and validating data from legacy systems and spreadsheets (strong Excel; SQL a plus).
* Strong training and communication skills, with the credibility to win over shop-floor, front-office and finance users alike.
* Residence on the U.S. West Coast (Arizona, California, Nevada, Oregon or Washington) within 30 minutes of a major commercial airport.
* Willingness to travel 40–60% to sites located on the West Coast, with occasional trips to the East Coast, and to work early, late or weekend hours during cutovers.
* Ability to work on ITAR-controlled programs (U.S. person status required).

**Preferred qualifications**

* JobBOSS² implementation experience.
* Experience converting between ERPs, especially Epicor or Infor to JobBOSS² or similar.
* Experience in aerospace, defense, semiconductor, space or medical precision machining, or similar high-mix, low-volume environments.
* Experience integrating companies after acquisitions, or across multiple sites.
* Familiarity with AS9100, ITAR, DFARS and CMMC requirements as they apply to ERP data and access.
* Experience with QuickBooks or other accounting integrations, Power BI or ERP reporting tools.
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Business, Industrial Engineering or a related field.
* Project management certification (PMP, CAPM) or ERP vendor certification.

Compensation Range: $90K - $120K

new_jobs.description:
**Who we are**

At Picnic, we're reinventing the way employees experience lunch at work. By partnering with top local restaurants and batching hundreds of orders, we make it easy for companies to offer high-quality, individually packed meals, without fees or tips. Our mission is to create a seamless, affordable, and joyful lunch experience that benefits both employees and employers.

  

**What you'll do**

We are looking for a **City Operations Associate** to support our operations team in San Francisco. This is an entry-level opportunity for a recent graduate or someone with up to one year of professional experience who is excited to learn, take ownership, and grow in a fast-paced environment.

* Support the operations organization by ensuring operational data is accurate and users are properly set up across operating systems.
* Run quality assurance and data audit activities to ensure information is accurate and up to date.
* Manage process-based operational needs, such as payments, alcohol applications, tobacco licenses, health permits, and other administrative requirements, liaising with external counsel as needed.
* Train and support the operations team on the use of internal systems, acting as a key point of contact via phone and email.
* Support other Business Operations activities as needed.

  

**What we're looking for**

* **Recent graduate or up to one year of professional experience.**
* **Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.**
* Ability to think strategically and act tactically; you enjoy rolling up your sleeves and making things happen.
* Strong communication, organization, and project management skills.
* Entrepreneurial, resourceful, and comfortable working through ambiguity.
* Strong attention to detail and willingness to learn.
* Passion for food, startups, or improving the future of office-based culture.

  

**Why join us**

* Drive real impact: Be part of building the operational engine behind a fast-growing startup that's redefining how work gets done.
* Own your city: Take full ownership of your city's performance and see the direct results of your ideas and execution every single day.
* Work with purpose: Join a mission-driven team focused on making the workplace experience better for thousands of people.
* Grow with us**:** At Picnic, there's room to grow—personally and professionally—as we scale and take on new challenges together.

  

**What else you need to know**

This role is based in our San Francisco office location. As a company driven by innovation and continuous change, close collaboration is essential. We're constantly reimagining our industry, creating new products, and refining our processes, and we do our best work together. That's why all of our office-based teams work onsite, five days a week.

We are Industrious.

new_jobs.description:
**Location: San Francisco, California**
  
**Job Type: Contract**
  
**Compensation Range: $26 - 35 per hour**
  
  
We are looking for a proactive, detail-oriented **Office Manager** to serve as the operational backbone and welcoming face of our San Francisco office. Supporting a dynamic, collaborative team of approximately 85 corporate and retail operations employees, you will ensure our physical workspace runs seamlessly, safely, and efficiently every day. From managing front-desk hospitality and vendor logistics to keeping our kitchen stocked and facilities spotless, you will directly shape our daily workplace culture.
  
  
This role is a full time contract with potential to convert to FTE.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**
  
**Front Desk, Hospitality & Security**

* Serve as the primary point of contact at the front desk-warmly greeting employees, prospective candidates, brand partners, and vendors.
* Manage office access control, including issuing and tracking employee badges, registering guests, and overseeing front-door security protocols.
* Maintain an organized, welcoming reception area that reflects our retail brand aesthetic.

**Mail, Shipping & Deliveries**

* Receive, sort, log, and distribute all incoming mail, packages, and retail product samples promptly.
* Coordinate outbound domestic and international shipments for corporate teams and merchandising departments.
* Manage loading dock or building freight elevator schedules for larger deliveries and vendor drop-offs.

**Workplace Operations & Maintenance**

* Oversee daily office cleanliness and tidiness, acting as the primary liaison with building management, janitorial crews, and maintenance vendors.
* Conduct regular walkthroughs of conference rooms, common areas, and workstations to ensure spaces are clean, organized, and ready for use.
* Submit and track building maintenance tickets (HVAC, lighting, plumbing, repairs) through resolution.

**Kitchen, Pantry & Inventory Management**

* Maintain a fully stocked, clean, and well-organized office kitchen and break room, ensuring snacks, beverages, coffee, and break room essentials are replenished consistently.
* Manage inventory and place recurring orders for office supplies, shipping materials, and wellness/first-aid items while adhering to monthly budgets.
* Coordinate catering for internal meetings, company town halls, and team celebrations.

**Employee Experience & Ad-Hoc Support**

* Assist with onboarding logistics for new hires, including desk setup, welcome swag bags, and building orientation.
* Partner with HR and leadership to help plan and execute in-office cultural events, happy hours, and seasonal gatherings.
* Provide general administrative support to leadership and cross-functional teams as needed.

**Qualifications & Skills:**

* Experience: 4+ years of experience in office management, workplace operations, hospitality, or front-desk administration (experience in retail, lifestyle, or fast-paced corporate environments is a plus).
* Communication: Warm, polished, and professional demeanor with strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Organization: Exceptional multitasking abilities with sharp attention to detail; able to pivot quickly between competing priorities without dropping the ball.
* Tech Savvy: Comfortable using Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Sheets) or Microsoft Office, Slack, visitor management systems (e.g., Envoy), and basic office equipment.
Physical Requirements: Ability to be on-site Monday through Friday and comfortably lift/move boxes and deliveries up to 35 lbs.

**DATA INFRASTRUCTURE OPERATIONS SPECIALIST II (STARLINK)**

The Infrastructure Operations team is responsible for the end-to-end management of suppliers, costs, and delivery of high-quality human-generated data, including annotations, evaluations, and specialized research datasets that power the training, validation, and continuous improvement of our AI models. We're seeking talented, high-ownership individuals to grow and expand our global supplier network while ensuring the consistent, high-quality delivery of critical datasets. Individuals in this role are creative, fast problem-solvers who seek on challenges outside their comfort zone and can iterate and adapt at the rapid pace of the AI industry.

* Negotiate creative, flexible, and commercially effective deals with key suppliers and partners.
* Align sourcing strategy with engineering, quality, and performance requirements across priority areas.
* Track deal status, approvals, and execution risks while driving suppliers toward timely and reliable delivery.
* Continuously improve, standardize, and scale sourcing processes, workflows, tools, and planning systems.
* Build a strong pipeline of exclusive and proprietary enterprise datasets.
* Provide valuable inputs on upcoming orders based on supplier capacity, quality, and pricing.
* Maintain rigorous spend discipline, committing budget only to datasets that meaningfully improve model performance.
* Set target pricing, analyze supplier spend and trends, and develop metrics for quality, delivery, and performance.
* Manage clear, proactive communication with both internal stakeholders and external partners.

* Bachelor's degree and 3+ years of experience working in one or more of the following fields:
  + Hardware or product management
  + Engineering
  + Procurement
  + Supply chain management
  + Strategy and operations
  + Technology

* Self-starting, able to identify areas for improvement with minimal direction
* Experience in managing technical or construction projects from beginning to end
* Ability to tackle complex and ambiguous problems
* Excellent project management, communication, and organizational skills
* Experience or interest in data analysis, data visualization, and/or financial analysis
* Demonstrates commitment to SpaceX's goals of reusability, renewability, and sustainability

**ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Must be willing to work long hours and occasional weekends when necessary to support launch and critical project timelines

new_jobs.title: Group Product Manager, Commerce, Shopping Core Quality Lead
new_jobs.description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Mountain View, CA, USA; New York, NY, USA; Pittsburgh, PA, USA**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of experience in product management or related technical role.
* 5 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc.).
* Experience with technical Quality Product Management (e.g., ranking, retrieval, or ML model development).
* Experience building and launching products based on Generative AI or machine learning technologies.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master’s degree or other advanced degree in a technology or business related field.
* Demonstrated product experience guiding the post-training lifecycle of large language models (e.g., SFT, RLHF/RLAIF, DPO, instruction tuning, data curation, preference modeling) and domain-specific evaluation.
* Experience building scaled consumer-facing shopping, e-commerce, or marketplace products across the end-to-end commercial journey (inspiration, discovery, comparison, and purchase), within browser environments, mobile apps, or large-scale digital surfaces.
* Deep understanding of how to build AI-first products from the ground up, evidenced by integrating AI natively into product strategy rather than just applying it superficially.
* Deep understanding of the engaged landscape in Retail product, including emerging trends such as agentic commerce.
* Able to operate with high degrees of agency, autonomy, accountability, and customer empathy.

**About the job**
-----------------

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  
  
In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.  
  
One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

  

Google Ads and Commerce operates at the center of the global commercial journey. The Consumer Shopping organization is foundational to this ecosystem, building platforms and experiences for billions of consumers and merchants.  
  
Our mission is to “create seamless and coherent shopping journeys across Google, from Inspiration, Research and Consideration (R&C), Purchase, and Cross-Funnel, as well as AI-powered experiences that not only feel uniquely tailored to consumers' needs but also deliver great value for merchants.”
  
  
We provide comprehensive results for shoppers to discover, compare, and purchase products across Google Surfaces. We partner with the entire retail ecosystem—from large retailers to local shops—helping them build their brands, be discovered, and grow in today’s omnichannel world.

Users come first at Google. Nowhere is this more important than on our Advertising and Commerce team: we believe that ads and commercial information can be highly useful to our users if that information is relevant to what our users wish to find or do. Advertisers worldwide use Google Ads to promote their products; publishers use AdSense to serve relevant ads on their website; and business around the world use our products (like Google Shopping, and Google Wallet) to support their online businesses and bring users into their offline stores. We are constantly innovating to deliver the most effective advertising and commerce opportunities of tomorrow.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $240000 - $333000 (USD) + 25% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Drive the end-to-end product goal, strategy, and execution for Shopping across Google Search, AI Overviews, AI Mode, and the Gemini App.
* Partner directly with DeepMind (GDM) to improve Gemini models for Shopping, and collaborate with Merchant teams to enhance Shopping Tools.
* Define and defend crisp product goals, tracking appropriate metrics and developing effective measurement techniques.
* Create product requirements and lead product development in deep collaboration with Quality and Infrastructure Engineering, Content Design, Data Science, and Program Management (PgM).

At **ModMed**, we’re not just building software—we’re reimagining the healthcare experience. * Identify and facilitate upsell opportunities with customers as appropriate.

* Advocate customer needs/issues cross departmentally.
* Maintain regular communication (written and verbal) with customer escalations that you are owning.

* Suggest practical services offered by MMI to create a more efficient and autonomous office flow.
* Potential of owning your own small book of business.

***Skills & Requirements:***
----------------------------

* Bachelor's Degree, preferred.
* 1-2 years of relevant experience or equivalent combination of experience and education.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to navigate and mediate conflict.
* Detailed-oriented and organized.
* Ability to work independently as well as part of the customer success team.
* Professional, patient and balanced approach to handling tasks of varying priority and stress levels.
* Conflict resolution and problem solving skills.
* Ability to take initiative with little direction.
* Empathetic communicator with a consultative approach - able to see things from another person’s point of view.
* Working knowledge of Salesforce and Gainsight is a plus.
* Ability to multi-task and shift focus/priorities on-the-fly in a fast paced environment.
* People skills - you must be comfortable on the phone and able to engage in/control difficult discussions while maintaining professional composure.
* Motivated - we are a growing and ever-changing organization that is transforming how healthcare information is created, consumed and utilized to increase practice efficiency and improve patient outcomes.

**United States**

* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits, including a company Health Savings Account contribution,
* 401(k): ModMed provides a matching contribution each payday of 50% of your contribution deferred on up to 6% of your compensation. After one year of employment with ModMed, 100% of any matching contribution you receive is yours to keep.
* Generous Paid Time Off and Paid Parental Leave programs,
* Company paid Life and Disability benefits, Flexible Spending Account, and Employee Assistance Programs,
* Company-sponsored Business Resource & Special Interest Groups that provide engaged and supportive communities within ModMed,
* Professional development opportunities, including tuition reimbursement programs and unlimited access to LinkedIn Learning,
* Global presence and in-person collaboration opportunities; dog-friendly HQ (US), Hybrid office-based roles and remote availability for some roles,
* Weekly catered breakfast and lunch, treadmill workstations, Zen, and wellness rooms within our BRIC headquarters.

**PHISHING SCAM WARNING:** ModMed is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving imposters posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote "interviews," and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from ModMed without a formal interview process, and valid communications from our hiring team will come from our employees with a ModMed email address (first.lastname@modmed.com). new_jobs.description:
### **Company Introduction:**

Airspace is a tech-enabled freight forwarder that's redefining how the world's most critical packages are delivered. Headquartered in Carlsbad, California, Airspace has employees who are based around the world. Our European headquarters is in Amsterdam, The Netherlands.

As a recognized leader in AI and machine learning, our team leverages data and patented technology to coordinate logistics across a global network of drivers and airlines. Our goal is to deliver those packages that are truly mission-critical in a way that is faster, more transparent, more secure, and more accountable than ever before. The items we deliver range from organs for transplant, to parts for critical machinery including grounded aircraft and highly sensitive components such as semiconductors.

Airspace has been rated one of America's best Startup Employers and listed as one of CNBC's Disruptor 50 companies. Airspace has the support of leading investors such as Telstra Ventures, HarbourVest Partners, Defy Partners, DBL Partners, and Scale Ventures. To date the company has raised more than $140m.

The company is growing rapidly and serving more places around the world than ever before. We are looking for passionate, motivated individuals who want to make an IMPACT every day to help us execute on our mission of reshaping the world of time-critical logistics.

**Own the Judgment Calls That Keep Orders Moving**
--------------------------------------------------

Every shipment eventually hits a moment that isn't in the SOP — a failed carrier connection, an oversized load with no obvious coverage, a customer who needs a straight answer under pressure. As an Operations Specialist II, you're the person who resolves that moment without waiting for someone else to tell you how.

You've mastered the OS I fundamentals and are now trusted to act on incomplete information, source coverage other people can't, and de-escalate situations independently. This is where reactive execution starts becoming proactive ownership.

  

**What You'll Do**
------------------

*Must be able to perform all responsibilities included in the Operations Specialist I job description, in addition to the following:*

### **Resolve What Doesn't Fit the Standard Playbook**

* Independently start carrier traces for failed-to-load or unable-to-locate shipments
* Source driver coverage for any segment of an order, including oversized shipments
* Use bid/quote request tools to source specialized vehicles and provide cost estimates to customers
* Apply training and tenured knowledge to anticipate complications and proactively solve for them

### **Exercise Independent Judgment**

* De-escalate most situations without assistance
* Know when to escalate an order versus independently resolving it using available resources
